ts
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import '../templates/forms/style.css';
import App from '../templates/forms/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	createApp(App).mount(element);

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent -- Template layout follows the repository Prettier configuration. -->
<template>
	<PageFrame
		:session="session"
		:title="i18n.t('app.templates.forms.configureACombinedApplication')"
		:description="
			i18n.t('app.templates.forms.groupsCoverIdentityFinanceContactsSubmissionRules')
		"
		layout="advanced"
		:size="size"
		:readonly="readonly"
		:disabled="disabled"
		:error="error"
		@cancel="cancel"
		@loaded="syncModel"
		@locate="locatePageIssue"
		><p class="forms-help">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.initially5Groups30Fields5Detail') }}
		</p>
		<p v-if="pendingOptions" role="status">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.loadingOptionsForTheCurrentRegion') }}
		</p>
		<AsamSchemaForm
			v-if="model"
			ref="form"
			:model-value="model"
			:schema="schema"
			:session="session.revision.value"
			:size="size"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:disabled="disabled || session.editor.busy.value || session.state.value !== 'editing'"
			@update:model-value="updateModel"
			@submit="save"
			><template #actions="{ submit: validateAndSubmit }"
				><AsamButton
					class="template-message-button"
					type="primary"
					:size="size"
					:disabled="
						!session.writable.value ||
						session.editor.busy.value ||
						session.state.value !== 'editing'
					"
					@click="submitSchema(validateAndSubmit)"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.validateAllGroupsAndSave') }}</AsamButton
				></template
			></AsamSchemaForm
		><template #summary
			><h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.modelAndSubmissionRules') }}</h2>
			<dl>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.detailRows') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ model?.items?.length ?? 0 }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.retainHiddenValuesAndSubmit') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.additionalInformationRetainedNote') }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.clearHiddenValuesAndOmit') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.additionalInformationTemporaryNote') }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.retainHiddenValuesAndOmit') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.contactInformationInternalNote') }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.currencyAndDate') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.cnyYuanCalendarDateNoAutomaticExchange') }}</dd>
			</dl>
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.expandTheErrorSummaryToLocateThe') }}</p></template

	>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamSchemaForm } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamSchemaSubmitModel, AsamSchemaValidation } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AdvancedModel, FormPageEvents, FormPageExpose, FormPageProps } from './Types.js';
import { advancedBindings } from './Models.js';
import { createAdvancedSchema } from './AdvancedSchema.js';
import { useFormPage } from './UsePage.js';
import { identityKey } from './Session.js';
import PageFrame from './PageFrame.vue';
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<FormPageProps>(), {
	size: 'default',
	configurationVersion: '1'
});
const emit = defineEmits<FormPageEvents>();
const { session, ready, error, isCurrent, captureGuard } = useFormPage(
	props,
	'P08',
	advancedBindings,
	(receipt) => emit('saved', receipt)
);
const model = shallowRef<AdvancedModel>();
const form = shallowRef<{
	submit(): Promise<AsamSchemaValidation>;
	locate(identity: string): Promise<void>;
}>();
const pendingOptions = ref(0);
const reads = new Set<symbol>();
watch(
	() => session.value.revision.value,
	() => {
		reads.clear();
		pendingOptions.value = 0;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => reads.clear());
const schema = computed(() => {
	void props.configurationVersion;
	const services = props.services,
		identity = { ...props.identity };
	return createAdvancedSchema(
		{
			async departments(region, request) {
				if (
					!isCurrent() ||
					request.signal.aborted ||
					session.value.services !== services ||
					identityKey(session.value.identity()) !== identityKey(identity)
				)
					throw new DOMException('选项会话已失效', 'AbortError');
				const token = Symbol('options');
				const clear = () => {
					if (reads.delete(token)) pendingOptions.value = reads.size;
				};
				reads.add(token);
				pendingOptions.value = reads.size;
				request.signal.addEventListener('abort', clear, { once: true });
				try {
					return await services.departments(region, request);
				} finally {
					request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', clear);
					clear();
				}
			}
		},
		identity
	);
});
let pendingSave: Promise<boolean> | undefined;
function syncModel() {
	const document = session.value.snapshot().document;
	model.value =
		document && typeof document === 'object' ? (document as AdvancedModel) : undefined;
}
watch(ready, syncModel, { immediate: true });
function updateModel(value: AdvancedModel) {
	if (!isCurrent()) return;
	model.value = value;
	session.value.replace({ document: value });
}
function save(payload: AsamSchemaSubmitModel<AdvancedModel>) {
	if (!isCurrent() || !session.value.writable.value || !model.value) return;
	// 015已处理隐藏映射；不将payload反写覆盖完整编辑模型。
	const active = session.value;
	if (!active.replace({ document: payload })) return;
	pendingSave = active.submit(captureGuard(active));
}
async function submitSchema(action: () => Promise<unknown>) {
	await action();
	return (await pendingSave) ?? false;
}
async function submit() {
	if (!isCurrent()) return false;
	pendingSave = undefined;
	await form.value?.submit();
	return (await pendingSave) ?? false;
}
async function locatePageIssue() {
	await nextTick();
	await form.value?.locate(JSON.stringify(['profile-name']));
}
function cancel() {
	if (isCurrent()) session.value.cancel();
	emit('cancel');
}
defineExpose<FormPageExpose>({
	reload: async () => {
		if (!isCurrent()) return;
		await session.value.reload();
		syncModel();
	},
	submit,
	verify: () => (isCurrent() ? session.value.verify() : Promise.resolve()),
	cancel
});
</script>
ts
import type { AsamFieldFormatContext } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import { asamFormControls, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamNestedSchema,
	validateAsamNumber,
	validateAsamTemporal
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamSchemaNode } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AdvancedModel, AdvancedRow, FormIdentity, FormServices } from './Types.js';

const isString = (value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === 'string';
const isNumber = (value: unknown): value is number =>
	typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value);
const isBoolean = (value: unknown): value is boolean => typeof value === 'boolean';
const stringValue = {
	control: asamFormControls.Input,
	componentProps: { clearable: true, validateEvent: false },
	isValue: isString,
	input: (value: string) => value,
	output: (value: string) => value,
	format: (value: string, context?: AsamFieldFormatContext) =>
		value || (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.notEntered') ?? '未填写'),
	clearValue: () => ''
};
const numberValue = {
	control: asamFormControls.InputNumber,
	componentProps: { min: 0, validateEvent: false },
	isValue: isNumber,
	input: (value: number | undefined) => {
		if (value === undefined) throw new TypeError('此数值必填；清空不会自动转换为0');
		return value;
	},
	output: (value: number) => value,
	format: (value: number) => String(value),
	clearValue: () => 0
};
const booleanValue = {
	control: asamFormControls.Switch,
	componentProps: { validateEvent: false },
	isValue: isBoolean,
	input: (value: boolean) => value,
	output: (value: boolean) => value,
	format: (value: boolean, context?: AsamFieldFormatContext) =>
		value
			? (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.yes') ?? '是')
			: (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.no') ?? '否'),
	clearValue: () => false
};

/** 5组：4×5个单值字段 + 5行×2个叶字段 = 30叶；rowKey为业务元数据，不冒充输入字段。 */
export function createAdvancedSchema(
	services: Pick<FormServices, 'departments'>,
	identity: FormIdentity
): readonly AsamSchemaNode[] {
	const profile = createAsamNestedSchema<AdvancedModel['profile']>();
	const finance = createAsamNestedSchema<AdvancedModel['finance']>();
	const contact = createAsamNestedSchema<AdvancedModel['contact']>();
	const policy = createAsamNestedSchema<AdvancedModel['policy']>();
	const row = createAsamNestedSchema<AdvancedRow>();
	const region = { id: 'profile-region', scope: 'root' as const };
	const publish = { id: 'policy-publish', scope: 'root' as const };
	const showPrivate = { id: 'contact-show-private', scope: 'root' as const };
	return [
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'profile',
			label: '01 申请身份',
			path: ['profile'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				profile.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'profile-name',
					label: '申请名称',
					path: ['name'],
					validate: (value) =>
						typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length >= 2
							? undefined
							: '申请名称至少两个字符'
				}),
				profile.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'profile-code',
					label: '业务编号（异步校验，reserved 被占用）',
					path: ['code'],
					validate: async (value, { signal }) => {
						await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
							const timer = setTimeout(done, 60);
							function done() {
								signal.removeEventListener('abort', stop);
								resolve();
							}
							function stop() {
								clearTimeout(timer);
								done();
							}
							signal.addEventListener('abort', stop, { once: true });
							if (signal.aborted) stop();
						});
						return signal.aborted
							? undefined
							: !value
								? '业务编号不能为空'
								: value === 'reserved'
									? '该业务编号已被占用'
									: undefined;
					}
				}),
				profile.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'profile-enabled',
					label: '启用申请',
					path: ['enabled']
				}),
				profile.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'profile-region',
					label: '地区（east / west）',
					path: ['region'],
					validate: (value) =>
						['east', 'west'].includes(String(value))
							? undefined
							: '地区仅支持 east / west'
				}),
				profile.field({
					id: 'profile-department',
					label: '当前地区部门（异步选项）',
					path: ['department'],
					control: asamFormControls.RemoteSelect,
					componentProps: {
						placeholder: '选择当前地区部门',
						clearable: true,
						validateEvent: false
					},
					isValue: isString,
					input: (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''),
					output: (value) => value,
					format: (value, context) =>
						value || (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.notSelected') ?? '待选择'),
					clearValue: () => '',
					dependsOn: [region],
					onDependencyChange: 'clear',
					resolveDataSource: (context) => {
						const selected = String(context.get(region));
						return defineAsamOptions().api({
							api: async (_params: string, context) =>
								services.departments(selected, {
									...identity,
									page: 'P08',
									signal: context.signal
								}),
							params: selected
						});
					}
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'finance',
			label: '02 财务信息',
			path: ['finance'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				finance.field({
					...numberValue,
					id: 'finance-amount',
					label: '预算（CNY 元，不换币）',
					path: ['amount'],
					componentProps: { min: 0, validateEvent: false },
					validate: (value) =>
						validateAsamNumber(value, {
							key: 'amount',
							label: '预算',
							precision: 2,
							min: 0,
							required: true
						})
							.map((issue) => issue.message)
							.join('；') || undefined
				}),
				finance.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'finance-currency',
					label: '币种（只读）',
					path: ['currency'],
					readonly: true,
					validate: (value) =>
						value === 'CNY'
							? undefined
							: '当前模板仅声明CNY；请由宿主明确处理币种，不自动换汇'
				}),
				finance.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'finance-cost-code',
					label: '成本中心',
					path: ['costCode']
				}),
				finance.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'finance-invoice',
					label: '需要发票',
					path: ['invoice']
				}),
				finance.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'finance-tax-note',
					label: '开票说明（未选发票时禁用）',
					path: ['taxNote'],
					dependsOn: [{ id: 'finance-invoice' }],
					disabled: (context) => context.get({ id: 'finance-invoice' }) !== true
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'contact',
			label: '03 联系信息',
			path: ['contact'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-name',
					label: '联系人',
					path: ['name']
				}),
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-phone',
					label: '联系电话（保留原文）',
					path: ['phone']
				}),
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-email',
					label: '邮箱',
					path: ['email'],
					validate: (value) =>
						/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(value))
							? undefined
							: '请输入完整邮箱'
				}),
				contact.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'contact-show-private',
					label: '展示内部备注',
					path: ['showPrivate']
				}),
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-private-note',
					label: '内部备注（隐藏保留，不提交）',
					path: ['privateNote'],
					dependsOn: [showPrivate],
					hidden: (context) => context.get(showPrivate) !== true,
					onHide: 'retain',
					submitHidden: false
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'policy',
			label: '04 提交策略',
			path: ['policy'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				policy.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'policy-publish',
					label: '发布补充信息',
					path: ['publish']
				}),
				policy.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'policy-keep-note',
					label: '保留说明（隐藏保留且提交）',
					path: ['keepNote'],
					dependsOn: [publish],
					hidden: (context) => context.get(publish) !== true,
					onHide: 'retain',
					submitHidden: true
				}),
				policy.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'policy-clear-note',
					label: '临时说明（隐藏清空且省略）',
					path: ['clearNote'],
					dependsOn: [publish],
					hidden: (context) => context.get(publish) !== true,
					onHide: 'clear',
					submitHidden: false
				}),
				policy.field({
					id: 'policy-date',
					label: '计划日期（无时区）',
					path: ['date'],
					control: asamFormControls.DatePicker,
					componentProps: {
						type: 'date',
						valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
						validateEvent: false
					},
					isValue: isString,
					input: (value) => value ?? '',
					output: (value) => value,
					format: (value) => value,
					clearValue: () => '',
					validate: (value) =>
						validateAsamTemporal(value, {
							key: 'date',
							label: '计划日期',
							kind: 'date',
							required: true
						})
							.map((issue) => issue.message)
							.join('；') || undefined
				}),
				policy.field({
					id: 'policy-resource',
					label: '资料ID（只读合成引用，可为null）',
					path: ['resourceId'],
					control: asamFormControls.Input,
					componentProps: { validateEvent: false },
					readonly: true,
					isValue: (value): value is string | null =>
						value === null || typeof value === 'string',
					input: (value) => value,
					output: (value) => value ?? '',
					format: (value, context) =>
						value === null
							? (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.noResourceNull') ??
								'无资料 null')
							: value,
					clearValue: () => null
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'array',
			id: 'items',
			label: '05 设备明细',
			path: ['items'],
			rowKey: ['rowKey'],
			min: 1,
			max: 12,
			permissions: { add: true, remove: true, move: true },
			createRow: () => ({ rowKey: createTemplateId(), name: '新增设备', quantity: 0 }),
			children: [
				row.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'item-name',
					label: '设备名称',
					path: ['name'],
					validate: (value) =>
						typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? undefined : '设备名称不能为空'
				}),
				row.field({
					...numberValue,
					id: 'item-quantity',
					label: '设备数量',
					path: ['quantity'],

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,

const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	updateBoolean('dark', event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import BasicFormPage from './BasicFormPage.vue';
import StepsFormPage from './StepsFormPage.vue';
import AdvancedFormPage from './AdvancedFormPage.vue';
import { createSyntheticServices } from './SyntheticServices.js';
import type { SyntheticScenario } from './SyntheticServices.js';
import type { FormIdentity, FormPage, FormPageExpose, FormReceipt } from './Types.js';
const pages = [
	{
		id: 'P06',
		get title() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.forms.basicApplication');
		}
	},
	{
		id: 'P07',
		get title() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.forms.stepApplication');
		}
	},
	{
		id: 'P08',
		get title() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.forms.combinedApplication');
		}
	}
] as const;
const parsePage = (): FormPage =>
	pages.find((item) => location.hash === `#/${item.id}`)?.id ?? 'P06';
const page = ref<FormPage>(parsePage());
const onHash = () => {
	page.value = parsePage();
};
window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHash);
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash));
const currentPage = computed(() =>
	page.value === 'P06' ? BasicFormPage : page.value === 'P07' ? StepsFormPage : AdvancedFormPage
);
const identity = shallowRef<FormIdentity>({ scope: 'forms-demo', entity: 'A-001', version: '1' });
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const dark = ref(false),
	readonly = ref(false),
	disabled = ref(false),
	second = ref(false),
	mounted = ref(true);
const scenarios: SyntheticScenario[] = [
	'normal',
	'empty',
	'load-error',
	'invalid-model',
	'validation-error',
	'save-error',
	'unknown',
	'verify-unknown',
	'verify-not-applied'
];
const scenario = ref<SyntheticScenario>('normal');
function updateSize(value: unknown) {
	const next = sizes.find((item) => item === value);
	if (next !== undefined) size.value = next;
}
function updateScenario(value: unknown) {
	const next = scenarios.find((item) => item === value);
	if (next !== undefined) scenario.value = next;
}
const booleanControls = { dark, readonly, disabled, second, mounted };
function updateBoolean(key: keyof typeof booleanControls, value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') booleanControls[key].value = value;
}
const mock = createSyntheticServices(),
	secondMock = createSyntheticServices();
const view = ref<FormPageExpose>();
const savedCount = ref(0),
	lastReceipt = shallowRef<FormReceipt>();
function saved(receipt: FormReceipt) {
	savedCount.value++;
	lastReceipt.value = receipt;
}
function reload() {
	mock.setScenario(scenario.value);
	void view.value?.reload();
}
function switchIdentity() {
	identity.value = {
		scope: identity.value.scope,
		entity: identity.value.entity === 'A-001' ? 'A-002' : 'A-001',
		version: String(Number(identity.value.version) + 1)
	};
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { nextTick, useId } from 'vue';
import { AsamBaseForm, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { AsamFieldView } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldViewExpose } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { FormPageEvents, FormPageExpose, FormPageProps } from './Types.js';
import { basicBindings } from './Models.js';
import { useFormPage } from './UsePage.js';
import { validateBasic } from './Validation.js';
import PageFrame from './PageFrame.vue';
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<FormPageProps>(), {
	size: 'default',
	configurationVersion: '1'
});
const emit = defineEmits<FormPageEvents>();
const { session, error, isCurrent, captureGuard } = useFormPage(
	props,
	'P06',
	basicBindings,
	(receipt) => emit('saved', receipt),
	validateBasic
);
const uid = useId();
const moneyBinding = basicBindings.find((binding) => binding.field.key === 'budget')!;
const resourceBinding = basicBindings.find((binding) => binding.field.key === 'resource')!;
const fields = new Map<string, AsamFieldViewExpose>();
function setField(key: string, value: unknown) {
	if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'focus' in value && typeof value.focus === 'function')
		fields.set(key, value as AsamFieldViewExpose);
	else fields.delete(key);
}
async function locate(key?: string) {
	await nextTick();
	if (key) fields.get(key)?.focus();
}
async function submit() {
	if (!isCurrent()) return false;
	const active = session.value;
	const saved = await active.submit(captureGuard(active));
	if (!saved) await locate(session.value.editor.issues.value[0]?.key);
	return saved;
}
function cancel() {
	if (isCurrent()) session.value.cancel();
	emit('cancel');
}
defineExpose<FormPageExpose>({
	reload: () => (isCurrent() ? session.value.reload() : Promise.resolve()),
	submit,
	verify: () => (isCurrent() ? session.value.verify() : Promise.resolve()),
	cancel
});
</script>

import type { AsamFieldFormatContext } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { defineAsamOptions, defineAsamControl, AsamInput } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamFieldModes,
	createAsamMoneyField,
	createAsamNumberField,
	createAsamTemporalField,
	createAsamSwitchField,
	createAsamResourceField,
	cloneAsamFieldValue
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamFieldViewBinding,
	AsamFormStep
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AdvancedModel, FormPage } from './Types.js';

export const choiceSource = defineAsamOptions().static({
	options: [
		{ value: 0, label: '本地 · 数值零' },
		{ value: '0', label: '远程 · 字符串零' },
		{ value: false, label: '暂不分类 · false' }
	]
});
export const copyModel = (model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>): AsamFieldModel =>
	cloneAsamFieldValue(model) as AsamFieldModel;
// 仅用于编辑协调器承载已由页面协议检查的快照，从不渲染为输入控件。
const snapshotControl = defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
	component: AsamInput,
	emptyValue: () => undefined,
	sourceKinds: []
});
export function snapshotFields(bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[]): AsamFieldDefinition[] {
	return bindings.map(({ field }) => ({
		key: field.key,
		label: field.label,
		kind: 'custom',
		control: snapshotControl,
		isValue: () => true,
		emptyValue: () => undefined,
		isEmpty: (value) => value === undefined,
		format: (value) => JSON.stringify(value),
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		clone: (value) => cloneAsamFieldValue(value)
	}));
}
const text = (
	key: string,
	label: string
): Extract<AsamFieldDefinition, { kind: 'text' | 'textarea' }> => ({ key, label, kind: 'text' });
const references = createAsamResourceField({
	key: 'resource',
	label: '关联资料（仅合成引用，不上传文件）',
	services: {
		upload: async () => {
			throw new Error('本模板未授权上传文件');
		},
		resolve: async (ids, signal) =>
			signal.aborted ? [] : ids.map((id) => ({ id, name: `合成资料 ${id}` }))
	},
	modes: { edit: { readonly: true } }
});
export const basicBindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[] = [
	{ field: text('name', '申请名称') },
	{ field: text('code', '业务编号（字符串零保留类型）') },
	{ field: createAsamNumberField({ key: 'quantity', label: '数量', integer: true, min: 0 }) },
	{
		field: createAsamMoneyField({
			key: 'budget',
			label: '预算（CNY 元，精度两位）',
			currency: 'CNY',
			storageUnit: 'major',
			precision: 2,
			min: 0
		})
	},
	{
		field: createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'date',
			label: '计划日期（无时区日历日期）',
			kind: 'date'
		})
	},
	{ field: { key: 'category', label: '分类字典', kind: 'single', source: choiceSource } },
	{
		field: createAsamSwitchField({
			key: 'enabled',
			label: '启用申请',
			activeValue: true,
			inactiveValue: false
		})
	},
	{ field: { key: 'tags', label: '适用标签', kind: 'multiple', source: choiceSource } },
	{ field: { key: 'note', label: '说明（空字符串是明确值）', kind: 'textarea' } },
	{
		field: {
			...text('nullable', '可空备注（null 是明确空值）'),
			format: (value: string | null, context?: AsamFieldFormatContext) =>
				value === null
					? (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.emptyNull') ?? '明确为空 null')
					: value
		}
	},
	{ field: text('optional', '可选补充（缺失属性不会自动提交）') },
	{ field: references }
];
export const steps: readonly AsamFormStep[] = [
	{
		id: 'identity',
		title: '01 基本信息',
		keys: ['name', 'code', 'region', 'department', 'enabled']
	},
	{ id: 'plan', title: '02 执行计划', keys: ['quantity', 'budget', 'date', 'category', 'tags'] },
	{
		id: 'review',
		title: '03 联系与确认',
		keys: ['contact', 'email', 'note', 'nullable', 'confirmed']
	}
];
export const stepBindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[] = [
	...basicBindings.filter((binding) =>
		steps.some((step) => step.keys.includes(binding.field.key))
	),
	{
		field: {
			key: 'region',
			label: '地区',
			kind: 'single',
			source: defineAsamOptions().static({
				options: [
					{ value: 'east', label: '东部' },
					{ value: 'west', label: '西部' }
				]
			})
		}
	},
	{
		field: {
			key: 'department',
			label: '部门（随地区异步读取）',
			kind: 'single',
			source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options: [] })
		}
	},
	{ field: text('contact', '联系人') },
	{ field: text('email', '联系邮箱') },
	{
		field: createAsamSwitchField({
			key: 'confirmed',
			label: '确认资料真实（合成数据）',
			activeValue: true,
			inactiveValue: false
		})
	}
];
const documentField: AsamFieldDefinition = {
	key: 'document',
	label: '嵌套申请',
	kind: 'custom',
	control: snapshotControl,
	isValue: (value) => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value),
	emptyValue: () => advancedBaseline(),
	isEmpty: () => false,
	format: (value) => JSON.stringify(value),
	query: (value) => value,
	submit: (value) => value
};
export const advancedBindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[] = [{ field: documentField }];
export const bindingsFor = (page: FormPage) =>
	page === 'P06' ? basicBindings : page === 'P07' ? stepBindings : advancedBindings;
export function modesFor(bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[]) {
	return createAsamFieldModes({
		bindings,
		submit: bindings.map(({ field }) => ({
			field: field.key,
			output: field.key === 'resource' ? 'resourceId' : field.key
		}))
	});
}
export function advancedBaseline(): AdvancedModel {
	return {
		profile: {
			name: '区域设备申请',
			code: '0',
			enabled: false,
			region: 'east',
			department: ''
		},
		finance: { amount: 0, currency: 'CNY', costCode: '', invoice: false, taxNote: '' },
		contact: {
			name: '陈晓',
			phone: '',
			email: 'demo@example.invalid',
			showPrivate: true,
			privateNote: '实例内保留'
		},
		policy: {
			publish: true,
			keepNote: '隐藏时保留并提交',
			clearNote: '隐藏时清空且省略',
			date: '2026-10-19',
			resourceId: null
		},
		items: Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => ({
			rowKey: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? '0' : `line-${index}`,
			name: `设备 ${index + 1}`,
			quantity: index
		}))
	};
}
export function baseline(page: FormPage): AsamFieldModel {
	if (page === 'P08') return { document: advancedBaseline() };
	const common: AsamFieldModel = {
		name: '区域设备申请',
		code: '0',
		quantity: 0,
		budget: 0,
		date: '2026-10-19',
		category: 0,
		enabled: false,
		tags: [0, '0', false],
		note: '',
		nullable: null
	};
	return page === 'P06'
		? { ...common, resource: { id: 0, name: '合成资料 0' } }
		: {
				...common,
				region: 'east',
				department: 'east-ops',
				contact: '陈晓',
				email: 'demo@example.invalid',
				confirmed: true
			};
}

				<h1>{{ title }}</h1>
				<p class="forms-description">{{ description }}</p>
				<p v-if="readonly || disabled" class="forms-mode" role="status">
					{{
						readonly
							? i18n.t('app.templates.forms.readOnlyView')
							: i18n.t('app.templates.forms.pageDisabled')
					}}
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.newWritesAreCurrentlyUnavailable') }}
				</p>
			</header>
			<p v-if="error" role="alert">{{ error }}</p>
			<section
				v-else-if="session.state.value === 'loading'"
				class="forms-notice"
				role="status"
			>
				<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.loadingApplication') }}</h2>
				<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.thePageStructureRemainsWhileDataFor') }}</p>
			</section>
			<section
				v-else-if="
					['empty', 'load-error', 'cancelled', 'closed'].includes(session.state.value)
				"
				class="forms-notice"
			>
				<h2>
					{{
						session.state.value === 'empty'
							? i18n.t('app.templates.forms.applicationNotFound')
							: session.state.value === 'load-error'
								? i18n.t('app.templates.forms.unableToLoadRightNow')
								: i18n.t('app.templates.forms.thisEditingSessionIsClosed')
					}}
				</h2>
				<p>
					{{
						(session.editor.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? session.editor.message.value) ||
						i18n.t('app.templates.forms.closingThePageDoesNotUndoExternal')
					}}
				</p>
				<AsamButton
					class="template-message-button"
					:size="size"
					@click="reload"
					type="primary"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.reload') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					class="template-message-button"
					v-if="session.page === 'P07'"
					:size="size"
					@click="reopenDraft"
					type="primary"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.reopenInstanceDraft') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</section>
			<section
				v-else-if="session.result.value"
				class="forms-result"
				:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.forms.saveResult')"
				tabindex="-1"
			>
				<p class="forms-eyebrow">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.confirmedSaved') }}</p>
				<h2>{{ session.result.value.summary }}</h2>
				<dl>
					<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.entityVersion') }}</dt>
					<dd>{{ session.result.value.entity }} / {{ session.result.value.version }}</dd>
					<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.originalOperationId') }}</dt>
					<dd>{{ session.result.value.operationId }}</dd>
				</dl>
				<AsamButton
					class="template-message-button"
					:size="size"
					@click="newEdit"
					type="primary"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.returnAndEditAgain') }}</AsamButton
				><slot name="result" :receipt="session.result.value" />
			</section>
			<template v-else
				><div class="forms-workspace">
					<section class="forms-content"><slot /></section>
					<aside class="forms-aside">
						<slot name="summary"
							><h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.thisApplication') }}</h2>
							<p>
								{{
									i18n.t(
										'app.templates.forms.inputDisplayAndSubmittedValuesAreHandled'
									)
								}}
							</p>
							<dl>
								<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.entity') }}</dt>
								<dd>{{ session.identity().entity }}</dd>
								<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.version') }}</dt>
								<dd>{{ session.identity().version }}</dd>
							</dl></slot
						>
					</aside>
				</div>
				<div class="forms-feedback" aria-live="polite">
					<p v-if="session.editor.message.value" role="alert">
						{{ session.editor.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? session.editor.message.value }}
					</p>
					<ul
						v-if="session.editor.issues.value.length"
						:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.forms.pageErrors')"
					>
						<li v-for="(issue, index) in session.editor.issues.value" :key="index">
							<AsamButton
								class="forms-issue-link"
								type="danger"
								link
								native-type="button"
								@click="$emit('locate', issue.key)"
								>{{ formatFieldIssue(issue, i18n) }}</AsamButton
							>
						</li>
					</ul>
				</div>
				<div
					v-if="['unknown', 'verifying'].includes(session.state.value)"
					class="forms-notice"
					role="status"
				>
					<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.saveResultAwaitsVerification') }}</h2>
					<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.onlyTheOriginalOperationIsQueriedIt') }}</p>
					<AsamButton
						class="template-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="session.editor.busy.value"
						@click="session.verify"
						type="primary"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.verifyOriginalOperation') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div>
				<footer class="forms-actions">
					<slot name="actions" /><AsamButton
						class="template-message-button"
						:size="size"
						@click="$emit('cancel')"
						type="primary"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.closeEditor') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</footer></template
			>
		</main></AsamConfigProvider
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { FormPageSession } from './Types.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	session: FormPageSession;
	title: string;
	description: string;
	layout: 'basic' | 'steps' | 'advanced';
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	readonly?: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	error?: string;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ cancel: []; locate: [key?: string]; loaded: [] }>();
// 父页面在重开完成后同步其普通SFC的编辑模型。
async function reload() {
	if (props.error) return;
	await props.session.reload();
	emit('loaded');
}
async function reopenDraft() {
	if (props.error) return;
	await props.session.reopenDraft();
	emit('loaded');
}
async function newEdit() {
	if (props.error) return;
	await props.session.newEdit();
	emit('loaded');
}
</script>
ts
import {
	createAsamMessageIssue,
	createAsamMessageError,
	formatFieldError,
	formatFieldIssue
} from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAsamWriteCoordinator, useAsamEditor } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamEditIssue, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { copyModel, modesFor, snapshotFields } from './Models.js';
import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import type {
	FormIdentity,
	FormReceipt,
	FormRequest,
	FormSessionConfig,
	FormPageSession
} from './Types.js';

export const identityKey = (identity: FormIdentity) =>
	JSON.stringify([identity.scope, identity.entity, identity.version]);
const receiptMatches = (
	value: unknown,
	operationId: string,
	identity: FormIdentity
): value is FormReceipt =>
	!!value &&
	typeof value === 'object' &&
	'operationId' in value &&
	value.operationId === operationId &&
	'entity' in value &&
	value.entity === identity.entity &&
	'version' in value &&
	value.version === identity.version &&
	'summary' in value &&
	typeof value.summary === 'string';
const equal = (a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean => {
	if (Object.is(a, b)) return true;
	if (a === null || b === null || typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object') return false;
	if (a instanceof Date || b instanceof Date)
		return a instanceof Date && b instanceof Date && a.getTime() === b.getTime();
	const keys = Object.keys(a);
	return (
		Array.isArray(a) === Array.isArray(b) &&
		keys.length === Object.keys(b).length &&
		keys.every(
			(key) => Object.hasOwn(b, key) && equal(Reflect.get(a, key), Reflect.get(b, key))
		)
	);
};

/** 页面持有的会话；004 负责未决写与恰一次交付，页面负责业务身份/DTO/服务最后边界。 */
export function createFormPageSession(config: FormSessionConfig) {
	let identity = { ...config.identity };
	let epoch = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	let validation: AbortController | undefined;
	let prepared: AsamFieldModel | undefined;
	let validator = config.validate;
	const pageValidators = new Set<NonNullable<FormSessionConfig['validate']>>();
	let operationId = '';
	let loadingEmpty = false;
	const pendingIds = config.pendingOperations ?? new Map<string, string>();
	const drafts = new Map<string, AsamFieldModel>();
	const modes = modesFor(config.bindings);
	const initializationIssues = new WeakMap<Error, readonly AsamEditIssue[]>();
	const coordinator = config.coordinator ?? createAsamWriteCoordinator();
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: identityKey(identity) });
	const result = shallowRef<FormReceipt>();
	const empty = ref(false);
	const cancelled = ref(false);
	const revision = ref(0);
	const access = ref({ disabled: false, readonly: false });
	const submitGuard = shallowRef<() => boolean>();
	const canWrite = () => {
		const permitted = config.canWrite?.() !== false && submitGuard.value?.() !== false;
		return permitted && !disposed && !access.value.disabled && !access.value.readonly;
	};
	const current = (token: number, signal: AbortSignal) =>
		!disposed && token === epoch && !signal.aborted;
	const request = (signal: AbortSignal): FormRequest => ({
		...identity,
		page: config.page,
		signal
	});
	const editor = useAsamEditor({
		formatError: (cause, scope) => {
			const issues = cause instanceof Error && initializationIssues.get(cause);
			return issues
				? issues
						.map((issue) => formatFieldIssue(issue, scope))
						.join(scope.t('pro.fields.issueSeparator'))
				: formatFieldError(cause, scope);
		},
		fields: snapshotFields(config.bindings),
		runtime,
		coordinator,
		equals: Object.fromEntries(config.bindings.map((binding) => [binding.field.key, equal])),
		confirmDiscard: async () => true,
		load: async (_target, context) => {
			const token = epoch;
			const found = await config.services.load(request(context.signal));
			if (!current(token, context.signal))
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'读取会话已失效',
					'app.templates.forms.theReadSessionIsNoLongerCurrent'
				);
			loadingEmpty = found.status === 'empty';
			if (found.status === 'empty') return {};
			const initialized = modes.initializeResult(found.model, 'edit');
			if (initialized.status === 'error') {
				const cause = new Error(
					initialized.issues.map((issue) => issue.message).join('；')
				);
				initializationIssues.set(cause, initialized.issues);
				throw cause;
			}
			return initialized.data;
		},
		save: async (_payload, operation, context) => {
			// 此检查位于最后一次宿主回调之后及真实服务调用之前。
			const token = epoch;
			const target = { ...identity };
			if (
				!canWrite() ||
				!runtime.isCurrent(context) ||
				operation.target.operationId !== operationId ||
				!prepared
			)
				return Object.assign(
					createAsamMessageIssue(
						'当前页面不允许写入，尚未调用保存服务',
						'app.templates.forms.thisPageCurrentlyDoesNotAllowWritesTheSave'
					),
					{ status: 'failure' as const }
				);
			const dto = copyModel(prepared);
			const saved = await config.services.submit(dto, {
				...target,
				page: config.page,
				signal: context.signal,
				operationId: operation.target.operationId
			});
			// 服务已发送后，即使会话失效仍返回其真实结果供004记录，不给新页面发成功。
			if (saved.status === 'success') {
				if (!receiptMatches(saved.receipt, operation.target.operationId, target))
					return Object.assign(
						createAsamMessageIssue(
							'成功回执与原操作身份不符，请核实原操作',
							'app.templates.forms.theSuccessReceiptDoesNotMatchTheOriginalOperation'
						),
						{ status: 'unknown' as const }
					);
				if (current(token, context.signal)) result.value = undefined;
				return { status: 'success', data: saved.receipt };
			}
			return saved;
		},
		verify: async (operation, context) => {
			const target = { ...identity };
			const checked = await config.services.verify({
				...target,
				page: config.page,
				signal: context.signal,
				operationId: operation.target.operationId
			});
			if (checked.status === 'success') {
				return receiptMatches(checked.receipt, operation.target.operationId, target)
					? { status: 'success', data: checked.receipt }
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			}
			return checked;
		},
		onSaved: (event) => {
			if (
				disposed ||
				!receiptMatches(event.result, operationId, identity) ||
				event.scope !== runtime.scope
			)
				return;
			// 先完成内部状态，外部同步回调可立即换实体、禁用或销毁。
			result.value = { ...event.result };
			drafts.delete(identityKey(identity));
			pendingIds.delete(identityKey(identity));
			config.onSaved?.({ ...event.result });
		}
	});
	editor.setValidator(async () => {
		validation?.abort();
		const controller = (validation = new AbortController());
		const token = epoch;
		prepared = undefined;
		const input = copyModel(editor.model.value);
		const issues: AsamEditIssue[] = [];
		for (const check of [validator, ...pageValidators]) {
			if (!check) continue;
			issues.push(...(await check(copyModel(input), controller.signal)));
			if (!current(token, controller.signal) || !canWrite())
				return [
					createAsamMessageIssue(
						'校验会话或规则已变化',
						'app.templates.forms.theValidationSessionOrRulesChanged'
					)
				];
		}
		if (!current(token, controller.signal) || !canWrite())
			return [
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'会话或写权限已变化',
					'app.templates.forms.theSessionOrWritePermissionsChanged'
				)
			];
		if (issues.length) return issues;
		const dto = modes.transform(input, 'submit');
		if (dto.status === 'error') return dto.issues;
		const business = await config.services.validate(
			copyModel(dto.data),
			request(controller.signal)
		);
		if (!current(token, controller.signal) || !canWrite())
			return [
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'会话或写权限已变化',
					'app.templates.forms.theSessionOrWritePermissionsChanged'
				)
			];
		if (!business.length) prepared = copyModel(dto.data);
		return business;
	});
	function invalidate() {
		epoch++;
		revision.value++;
		validation?.abort();
		validation = undefined;
		prepared = undefined;
		submitGuard.value = undefined;
		runtime.invalidate();
	}
	async function open(
		next: FormIdentity = identity,
		options: { draft?: boolean; newOperation?: boolean } = {}
	) {
		if (disposed) return;
		if (!next.scope.trim() || !next.entity.trim() || !next.version.trim())
			throw new Error('scope/entity/version 必须显式提供');
		invalidate();
		identity = { ...next };
		runtime.setScope(identityKey(identity));
		result.value = undefined;
		empty.value = false;
		cancelled.value = false;
		loadingEmpty = false;
		const key = identityKey(identity);
		const existingId = pendingIds.get(key);
		const existing = existingId && coordinator.get(runtime.scope, existingId);
		// 未知/在途/已确认写绝不换operationId来绕过去重。
		operationId =
			existingId && existing && existing.status !== 'not-applied'
				? existingId
				: (!options.newOperation && existingId) || `${config.page}:${createTemplateId()}`;
		pendingIds.set(key, operationId);
		const token = epoch;
		await editor.open({ mode: 'edit', id: identity.entity, operationId });
		if (disposed || token !== epoch) return;
		empty.value = loadingEmpty;
		if (options.draft && drafts.has(key) && editor.status.value === 'editing')
			editor.replace(drafts.get(key)!);
	}
	function retainDraft() {
		if (!disposed && editor.status.value === 'editing')
			drafts.set(identityKey(identity), copyModel(editor.model.value));
	}
	function cancel() {
		retainDraft();
		invalidate();
		cancelled.value = true;
		result.value = undefined;
	}
	function dispose() {
		if (disposed) return;
		invalidate();
		disposed = true;
		drafts.clear();
		pageValidators.clear();
		editor.dispose();
	}
	function update(key: string, value: unknown) {
		return canWrite() && !empty.value && editor.update(key, value);
	}
	function replace(model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>) {
		return canWrite() && !empty.value && editor.replace(copyModel(model));
	}
	return {
		page: config.page,
		services: config.services,
		editor: Object.freeze({
			model: editor.model,
			status: editor.status,
			issues: editor.issues,
			message: editor.message,
			formatMessage: editor.formatMessage,
			busy: editor.busy,
			dirty: editor.dirty,
			visible: editor.visible,
			writable: computed(canWrite)
		}),
		result,
		empty,
		cancelled,
		revision,
		identity: () => ({ ...identity }),
		operationId: () => operationId,
		state: computed(() =>
			result.value
				? 'result'
				: cancelled.value
					? 'cancelled'
					: empty.value
						? 'empty'
						: editor.status.value
		),
		writable: computed(canWrite),
		open,
		update,
		replace,
		cancel,
		dispose,
		retainDraft,
		snapshot: () => copyModel(editor.model.value),
		setValidator: (next: typeof validator) => {
			validation?.abort();
			validator = next;
		},
		addValidator(next: NonNullable<FormSessionConfig['validate']>) {
			validation?.abort();
			pageValidators.add(next);
			return () => {
				if (pageValidators.delete(next)) validation?.abort();
			};
		},
		setAccess(disabled: boolean, readonly: boolean) {
			if (access.value.disabled === disabled && access.value.readonly === readonly) return;
			validation?.abort();
			access.value = { disabled, readonly };
		},
		submit: async (guard?: () => boolean) => {
			if (
				!canWrite() ||
				empty.value ||
				cancelled.value ||
				result.value ||
				editor.status.value !== 'editing' ||
				guard?.() === false
			)
				return false;
			const token = epoch;
			submitGuard.value = guard;
			try {
				await editor.submit();
				return !disposed && token === epoch && !!result.value;
			} finally {
				if (submitGuard.value === guard) submitGuard.value = undefined;
			}
		},
		verify: async () => {
			if (!disposed) await editor.verify();
		},
		reload: () => open(identity),
		reopenDraft: () => open(identity, { draft: true }),
		newEdit: () => open(identity, { newOperation: true })
	};
}

/** 阶段容器可能因结果视图挂载而退出；业务布尔结果只认匹配原操作的真实回执。 */
export async function submitFormFlow(
	session: FormPageSession,
	submitFlow: () => Promise<boolean>,
	current: () => boolean
) {
	if (!current() || session.state.value !== 'editing') return false;
	const operationId = session.operationId();
	await submitFlow();
	return current() && session.result.value?.operationId === operationId;
}

<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent -- Template layout follows the repository Prettier configuration. -->
<template>
	<PageFrame
		:session="session"
		:title="i18n.t('app.templates.forms.createApplicationInSteps')"
		:description="i18n.t('app.templates.forms.setResponsibilitiesArrangeThePlanThenCheck')"
		layout="steps"
		:size="size"
		:readonly="readonly"
		:disabled="disabled"
		:error="error"
		@cancel="cancel"
		@locate="locate"
		@loaded="syncModel"
		><AsamStepsForm
			ref="flow"
			:model-value="model"
			:fields="flowFields"
			:steps="steps"
			:validate="validateCurrent"
			:submit-action="save"
			:size="size"
			:disabled="disabled || ['unknown', 'verifying'].includes(session.state.value)"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:active="
				!['closed', 'cancelled', 'empty', 'load-error', 'loading', 'result'].includes(
					session.state.value
				)
			"
			:allow-jump="false"
			@update:model-value="updateModel"
			@step-change="stepId = $event"
			@cancel="cancel"
			><template #default="{ step, model: currentModel, update }"
				><h2>{{ step.title }}</h2>
				<p class="forms-help">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.fieldsPerStep5MovingForwardValidates') }}
				</p>
				<p v-if="dependencies.loading" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.loadingDepartmentsForTheCurrentRegion') }}
				</p>
				<p v-if="dependencies.error" role="alert">
					{{ dependencies.error }}
					<AsamButton native-type="button" @click="loadDepartments" type="primary">{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.forms.reloadDepartments')
					}}</AsamButton>
				</p>
				<div
					v-for="binding in currentBindings(step.keys)"
					:key="binding.field.key"
					class="forms-field"
					:data-field="binding.field.key"
					role="group"
					:aria-labelledby="`step-${uid}-${binding.field.key}`"
				>
					<label :id="`step-${uid}-${binding.field.key}`">{{ binding.field.label }}</label
					><AsamFieldView
						:ref="(value) => setField(binding.field.key, value)"
						:binding="binding"
						:model-value="currentModel[binding.field.key]"
						context="edit"
						:session="session.revision.value"
						:size="size"
						:readonly="readonly"
						:disabled="
							disabled ||
							session.editor.busy.value ||
							session.state.value !== 'editing' ||
							(binding.field.key === 'department' && dependencies.loading)
						"
						@update:model-value="update(binding.field.key, $event)"
					/></div></template
			><template #actions="{ next, back }"
				><div class="forms-step-actions">
					<AsamButton
						class="template-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || session.editor.busy.value || stepId === steps[0]?.id"
						@click="back"
						type="primary"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.previous') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						class="template-message-button"
						v-if="stepId !== steps[2]?.id"
						type="primary"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || session.editor.busy.value"
						@click="advance(next)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.next') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						class="template-message-button"
						v-else
						type="primary"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="!session.writable.value || session.editor.busy.value"
						@click="submit"
						>{{
							i18n.t('app.templates.forms.reviewAndSaveTheFullApplication')
						}}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></template
			></AsamStepsForm
		><template #summary
			><h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.applicationSummary') }}</h2>
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.currentStep') }}{{ stepId }}</p>
			<dl>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.application') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ model.name }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.regionDepartment') }}</dt>
				<dd>
					{{ model.region }} /
					{{ model.department || i18n.t('app.templates.forms.notSelected') }}
				</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.quantity') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ model.quantity }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.confirmation') }}</dt>
				<dd>
					{{
						model.confirmed === true
							? i18n.t('app.templates.forms.confirmed')
							: i18n.t('app.templates.forms.awaitingConfirmation')
					}}
				</dd>
			</dl>
			<p class="forms-help">
				{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.draftsRemainInThisInstanceOnlyRecovery') }}
			</p>
			<AsamButton
				class="template-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled || session.editor.busy.value"
				@click="saveDraft"
				type="primary"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.retainDraft') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				class="template-message-button"
				v-if="draftAdapter"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled || session.editor.busy.value"
				@click="restoreDraft"
				type="primary"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.readHostDraft') }}</AsamButton
			>
			<p role="status">{{ displayedDraftMessage }}</p></template
		></PageFrame
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	createAsamMessageIssue,
	createAsamMessageError,
	formatFieldIssue
} from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamFieldView, AsamStepsForm } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamEditIssue,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamFieldViewBinding,
	AsamFieldViewExpose,
	AsamFlowContext
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { FormPageEvents, FormPageExpose, FormPageProps } from './Types.js';
import { copyModel, snapshotFields, stepBindings, steps } from './Models.js';
import { identityKey, submitFormFlow } from './Session.js';
import { useFormPage } from './UsePage.js';
import { validateStep } from './Validation.js';
import PageFrame from './PageFrame.vue';
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<FormPageProps>(), {
	size: 'default',
	configurationVersion: '1'
});
const emit = defineEmits<FormPageEvents>();
const { session, ready, error, isCurrent, captureGuard } = useFormPage(
	props,
	'P07',
	stepBindings,
	(receipt) => emit('saved', receipt),
	async (input, signal) =>
		validateStep(
			input,
			steps.flatMap((step) => step.keys),
			signal
		)
);
const model = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({});
const stepId = ref(steps[0]!.id);
const flow = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamStepsForm>>();
const flowFields = snapshotFields(stepBindings);
const uid = useId();
const fields = new Map<string, AsamFieldViewExpose>();
const dependencies = shallowRef<{
	loading: boolean;
	error: string;
	options: readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
}>({ loading: false, error: '', options: [] });
const draftMessage = ref('');
const draftSource = shallowRef<{ message: string }>();
const displayedDraftMessage = computed(() =>
	draftSource.value ? formatFieldIssue(draftSource.value, i18n) : draftMessage.value
);
let dependencyAbort: AbortController | undefined;
let draftAbort: AbortController | undefined;
let dependencyGeneration = 0;
let focusGeneration = 0;
let stepFailure: { key: string; stepId?: string; signal: AbortSignal } | undefined;
watch(
	() => [props.readonly, props.disabled],
	() => {
		focusGeneration++;
		stepFailure = undefined;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
function captureFocusGuard() {
	const current = session.value;
	const revision = current.revision.value;
	const generation = focusGeneration;
	const currentFlow = flow.value;
	const guard = captureGuard(current);
	return () =>
		guard() &&
		generation === focusGeneration &&
		currentFlow === flow.value &&
		revision === current.revision.value &&
		current.writable.value &&
		current.state.value === 'editing';
}
const bindings = computed<readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[]>(() =>
	stepBindings.map((binding) =>
		binding.field.key === 'department'
			? {
					field: {
						key: 'department',
						label: binding.field.label,
						kind: 'single',
						source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options: dependencies.value.options })
					}
				}
			: binding
	)
);
const currentBindings = (keys: readonly string[]) =>
	bindings.value.filter((binding) => keys.includes(binding.field.key));
function updateModel(next: AsamFieldModel) {
	if (!isCurrent()) return;
	model.value = next;
	session.value.replace(next);
}
function syncModel() {
	model.value = session.value.snapshot();
	stepId.value = steps[0]!.id;
	void nextTick(() => flow.value?.reset());
}
watch(ready, syncModel, { immediate: true });
watch(
	[() => model.value.region, () => ready.value, () => props.services],
	([region, loadRound], previous) => {
		if (
			previous &&
			typeof previous[0] === 'string' &&
			loadRound === previous[1] &&
			region !== previous[0] &&
			session.value.state.value === 'editing' &&
			!props.readonly &&
			!props.disabled
		) {
			updateModel({ ...model.value, department: null });
		}
		void loadDepartments();
	}
);
async function loadDepartments() {
	dependencyAbort?.abort();
	const token = ++dependencyGeneration;
	const current = session.value;
	const revision = current.revision.value;
	const region = model.value.region;
	if (!isCurrent() || typeof region !== 'string' || current.state.value !== 'editing') return;
	const controller = (dependencyAbort = new AbortController());
	dependencies.value = { loading: true, error: '', options: [] };
	try {
		const options = await props.services.departments(region, {
			...props.identity,
			page: 'P07',
			signal: controller.signal
		});
		if (
			!isCurrent() ||
			controller.signal.aborted ||
			token !== dependencyGeneration ||
			current !== session.value ||
			revision !== current.revision.value ||
			model.value.region !== region
		)
			return;
		dependencies.value = { loading: false, error: '', options };
	} catch (cause) {
		if (
			!controller.signal.aborted &&
			token === dependencyGeneration &&
			revision === current.revision.value
		)
			dependencies.value = { loading: false, error: String(cause), options: [] };
	}
}
async function validateCurrent(
	input: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
	keys: readonly string[],
	context: AsamFlowContext
): Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]> {
	const current = captureFocusGuard();
	const issues = [...(await validateStep(input, keys, context.signal))];
	if (keys.includes('department') && (dependencies.value.loading || dependencies.value.error))
		issues.push(
			Object.assign(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'部门读取尚未成功，请等待或重试',
					'app.templates.forms.departmentsHaveNotLoadedSuccessfullyWaitOrRetry'
				),
				{ key: 'department' }
			)
		);
	if (current() && !context.signal.aborted) {
		const key = issues.find((issue) => issue.key && keys.includes(issue.key))?.key;
		stepFailure = key ? { key, stepId: context.stepId, signal: context.signal } : undefined;
	}
	return issues;
}
async function save(_containerPayload: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>, context: AsamFlowContext) {
	if (!isCurrent() || context.signal.aborted || !session.value.writable.value)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			'页面不可写',
			'app.templates.forms.thisPageDoesNotAllowWrites'
		);
	// 容器只处理阶段；从原编辑模型转换DTO，不把finish或容器payload当保存回执。
	const active = session.value;
	active.replace(model.value);
	if (!(await active.submit(captureGuard(active))))
		throw session.value.editor.message.value
			? new Error(session.value.editor.message.value)
			: createAsamMessageError(
					'页面保存尚未确认',
					'app.templates.forms.thePageSaveIsNotYetConfirmed'
				);
}
async function submit() {
	if (!isCurrent() || !flow.value) return false;
	const previousFailure = stepFailure;
	const current = captureFocusGuard();
	const active = session.value;
	const previousIssues = active.editor.issues.value;
	const saved = await submitFormFlow(active, () => flow.value!.submit(), captureGuard(active));
	if (!saved && current()) {
		if (stepFailure && stepFailure !== previousFailure) await focusStepFailure(current);
		else if (active.editor.issues.value !== previousIssues)
			await locate(active.editor.issues.value[0]?.key, true, current);
	}
	return saved;
}
async function advance(next: () => Promise<boolean>) {
	const previousFailure = stepFailure;
	const current = captureFocusGuard();
	if (!(await next()) && stepFailure !== previousFailure) await focusStepFailure(current);
}
async function focusStepFailure(current: () => boolean) {
	const failure = stepFailure;
	if (!failure) return;
	const valid = () => current() && !failure.signal.aborted && failure.stepId === stepId.value;
	if (valid()) await locate(failure.key, false, valid);
}
function setField(key: string, value: unknown) {
	if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'focus' in value)
		fields.set(key, value as AsamFieldViewExpose);
	else fields.delete(key);
}
async function locate(key?: string, navigate = true, current = captureFocusGuard()) {
	if (!key || !current()) return;
	const step = steps.find((step) => step.keys.includes(key));
	if (!step) return;
	if (navigate) await flow.value?.go(step.id);
	await nextTick();
	if (current() && step.id === stepId.value) fields.get(key)?.focus();
}
function setDraftMessage(issue: { message: string }) {
	draftMessage.value = issue.message;
	draftSource.value = issue;
}
async function saveDraft() {
	const current = session.value;
	if (!isCurrent() || !current.writable.value || current.editor.busy.value) return;
	current.retainDraft();
	setDraftMessage(
		createAsamMessageIssue(
			'已保留当前实例草稿',
			'app.templates.forms.theDraftIsRetainedInThisInstance'
		)
	);
	if (!props.draftAdapter) return;
	draftAbort?.abort();
	const controller = (draftAbort = new AbortController());
	const revision = current.revision.value;
	try {
		await props.draftAdapter.write(
			{
				format: 'asam-forms-draft-v1',
				identity: { ...props.identity },
				page: 'P07',
				model: copyModel(model.value)
			},
			{ ...props.identity, page: 'P07', signal: controller.signal }
		);
		if (isCurrent() && !controller.signal.aborted && revision === current.revision.value)
			setDraftMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'版本化宿主草稿已确认写入',
					'app.templates.forms.theVersionedHostDraftWriteWasConfirmed'
				)
			);
	} catch (cause) {
		if (!controller.signal.aborted && revision === current.revision.value)
			setDraftMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					`草稿写入未确认：${String(cause)}`,
					'app.templates.forms.draftWriteError',
					{ cause: String(cause) }
				)
			);
	}
}
async function restoreDraft() {
	if (
		!isCurrent() ||
		!props.draftAdapter ||
		!session.value.writable.value ||
		session.value.editor.busy.value
	)
		return;
	draftAbort?.abort();
	const controller = (draftAbort = new AbortController());
	const current = session.value,
		revision = current.revision.value;
	try {
		const draft = await props.draftAdapter.read({
			...props.identity,
			page: 'P07',
			signal: controller.signal
		});
		if (
			controller.signal.aborted ||
			current !== session.value ||
			revision !== current.revision.value ||
			!current.writable.value
		)
			return;
		if (
			!draft ||
			draft.format !== 'asam-forms-draft-v1' ||
			draft.page !== 'P07' ||
			identityKey(draft.identity) !== identityKey(props.identity)
		) {
			setDraftMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'没有同身份、同版本的可用草稿',
					'app.templates.forms.noDraftIsAvailableForThisIdentityAndRevision'
				)
			);
			return;
		}
		updateModel(copyModel(draft.model));
		setDraftMessage(
			createAsamMessageIssue(
				'已读取版本化草稿',
				'app.templates.forms.theVersionedDraftWasLoaded'
			)
		);
	} catch (cause) {
		if (!controller.signal.aborted && revision === current.revision.value)
			setDraftMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					`草稿读取失败：${String(cause)}`,
					'app.templates.forms.draftReadError',
					{ cause: String(cause) }
				)
			);
	}
}
watch(
	() => session.value.revision.value,
	() => {
		dependencyAbort?.abort();
		draftAbort?.abort();
	}
);
watch(
	() => [identityKey(props.identity), props.services, props.configurationVersion, props.session],
	() => {
		dependencyAbort?.abort();
		draftAbort?.abort();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
function cancel() {
	focusGeneration++;
	stepFailure = undefined;
	if (isCurrent()) {
		session.value.replace(model.value);
		session.value.cancel();
	}
	dependencyAbort?.abort();
	draftAbort?.abort();
	emit('cancel');
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	focusGeneration++;
	stepFailure = undefined;
	dependencyAbort?.abort();
	draftAbort?.abort();
});
defineExpose<FormPageExpose>({
	reload: async () => {
		if (!isCurrent()) return;
		await session.value.reload();
		syncModel();
	},
	submit,
	verify: () => (isCurrent() ? session.value.verify() : Promise.resolve()),
	cancel
});
</script>
ts
import { baseline, copyModel } from './Models.js';
import { identityKey } from './Session.js';
import type { FormReceipt, FormRequest, FormServices, FormWrite } from './Types.js';

export type SyntheticScenario =
	| 'normal'
	| 'empty'
	| 'load-error'
	| 'invalid-model'
	| 'validation-error'
	| 'save-error'
	| 'unknown'
	| 'verify-unknown'
	| 'verify-not-applied';
/** 一个工厂调用一个内存后端；不跨实例共享、不读写浏览器持久存储。 */
export function createSyntheticServices(initial: SyntheticScenario = 'normal') {
	let scenario = initial;
	const writes = new Map<string, { receipt: FormReceipt; dto: object }>();
	const records = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof baseline>>();
	const calls: { operation: string; identity: string; operationId?: string }[] = [];
	const record = (operation: string, request: FormRequest, operationId?: string) =>
		calls.push({ operation, identity: identityKey(request), operationId });
	const pause = (signal: AbortSignal, ms = 100) =>
		new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			if (signal.aborted) return reject(new DOMException('会话取消', 'AbortError'));
			const cancel = () => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				reject(new DOMException('会话取消', 'AbortError'));
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				resolve();
			}, ms);
			signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		});
	const key = (request: FormWrite) =>
		JSON.stringify([identityKey(request), request.page, request.operationId]);
	const recordKey = (request: FormRequest) =>
		JSON.stringify([identityKey(request), request.page]);
	function decode(dto: Readonly<ReturnType<typeof baseline>>, request: FormRequest) {
		const previous = records.get(recordKey(request)) ?? baseline(request.page);
		if (request.page === 'P08') {
			const merge = (base: unknown, value: unknown): unknown => {
				if (value === undefined) return base;
				if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
					return value;
				const original = base && typeof base === 'object' ? base : {};
				return Object.fromEntries(
					[...new Set([...Object.keys(original), ...Object.keys(value)])].map((key) => [
						key,
						merge(Reflect.get(original, key), Reflect.get(value, key))
					])
				);
			};
			return copyModel({ document: merge(previous.document, dto.document) });
		}
		const model = copyModel(dto);
		if (
			model.budget !== null &&
			typeof model.budget === 'object' &&
			model.budget &&
			'amount' in model.budget &&
			'currency' in model.budget &&
			'unit' in model.budget
		) {
			if (
				model.budget.currency !== 'CNY' ||
				model.budget.unit !== 'major' ||
				typeof model.budget.amount !== 'number'
			)
				throw new Error('合成服务只接受显式CNY元金额');
			model.budget = model.budget.amount;
		}
		if (request.page === 'P06') {
			model.resource = model.resourceId;
			delete model.resourceId;
		}
		return model;
	}
	const services: FormServices = {
		async load(request) {
			record('load', request);
			await pause(request.signal);
			if (scenario === 'load-error') throw new Error('合成读取失败，可恢复后重试');
			if (scenario === 'invalid-model')
				return {
					status: 'found',
					model:
						request.page === 'P08'
							? { document: {} }
							: { ...baseline(request.page), quantity: '0' }
				};
			return scenario === 'empty'
				? { status: 'empty' }
				: {
						status: 'found',
						model: copyModel(records.get(recordKey(request)) ?? baseline(request.page))
					};
		},
		async validate(dto, request) {
			record('validate', request);
			await pause(request.signal, 40);
			if (scenario === 'validation-error')
				return [
					{
						key: request.page === 'P08' ? 'document' : 'name',
						message: '合成页面校验未通过，请更正后提交'
					}
				];
			if (request.page !== 'P08' && dto.code === 'reserved')
				return [{ key: 'code', message: '业务编号已被占用' }];
			return [];
		},
		async submit(dto, request) {
			record('submit', request, request.operationId);
			await pause(request.signal);
			if (scenario === 'save-error')
				return {
					status: 'failure',
					message: '合成保存未生效，可显式再次保存',
					issues: [{ key: 'name', message: '请确认申请名称' }]
				};
			const receipt: FormReceipt = {
				operationId: request.operationId,
				entity: request.entity,
				version: request.version,
				summary: `申请 ${request.entity} 已保存（合成内存服务）`
			};
			writes.set(key(request), { receipt, dto: copyModel(dto) });
			if (scenario !== 'verify-not-applied')
				records.set(recordKey(request), decode(dto, request));
			return ['unknown', 'verify-unknown', 'verify-not-applied'].includes(scenario)
				? { status: 'unknown', message: '保存响应未知；仅核实原操作，不自动重发' }
				: { status: 'success', receipt };
		},
		async verify(request) {
			record('verify', request, request.operationId);
			await pause(request.signal);
			if (scenario === 'verify-unknown') return { status: 'unknown' };
			if (scenario === 'verify-not-applied') {
				writes.delete(key(request));
				return { status: 'not-applied' };
			}
			const saved = writes.get(key(request));
			return saved
				? { status: 'success', receipt: { ...saved.receipt } }
				: { status: 'not-applied' };
		},
		async departments(region, request) {
			record('departments', request);
			await pause(request.signal);
			return [
				{ value: `${region}-ops`, label: region === 'east' ? '东部运营' : '西部运营' },
				{ value: `${region}-lab`, label: '研究支持' }
			];
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		calls,
		writes,
		setScenario: (next: SyntheticScenario) => {
			scenario = next;
		}
	};
}
ts
import type { createFormPageSession } from './Session.js';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamEditIssue,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamWriteCoordinator,
	AsamFieldViewBinding
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamMoneyInputValue,
	AsamMoneyPayload,
	AsamResourceValue
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

export interface BasicInputModel {
	name: string;
	code: string;
	quantity: number | null;
	budget: AsamMoneyInputValue;
	date: string | null;
	category: AsamValue | null;
	enabled: boolean | null;
	tags: readonly AsamValue[];
	note: string;
	nullable: string | null;
	optional?: string;
	resource: AsamResourceValue;
}
export interface BasicSubmitDto extends Omit<BasicInputModel, 'budget' | 'resource'> {
	budget: AsamMoneyPayload | null;
	resourceId: string | number | null;
}
export interface StepsInputModel extends Omit<BasicInputModel, 'resource' | 'optional'> {
	region: string;
	department: string | null;
	contact: string;
	email: string;
	confirmed: boolean;
}
export interface StepsSubmitDto extends Omit<StepsInputModel, 'budget'> {
	budget: AsamMoneyPayload | null;
}

export type FormPage = 'P06' | 'P07' | 'P08';
export interface FormIdentity {
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly entity: string;
	/** 不推断后端版本；变化即开始新会话。 */
	readonly version: string;
}
export interface FormRequest extends FormIdentity {
	readonly page: FormPage;
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
}
export interface FormWrite extends FormRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface FormReceipt {
	readonly operationId: string;
	readonly entity: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly summary: string;
}
export type FormLoad =
	{ readonly status: 'found'; readonly model: AsamFieldModel } | { readonly status: 'empty' };
export type FormSubmit =
	| { readonly status: 'success'; readonly receipt: FormReceipt }
	| {
			readonly status: 'failure';
			readonly message: string;
			readonly issues?: readonly AsamEditIssue[];
	  }
	| { readonly status: 'unknown'; readonly message: string };
export type FormVerify =
	| { readonly status: 'success'; readonly receipt: FormReceipt }
	| { readonly status: 'not-applied' | 'unknown' };
export interface FormServices {
	load(request: FormRequest): Promise<FormLoad>;
	validate(
		dto: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		request: FormRequest
	): Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>;

	verify(request: FormWrite): Promise<FormVerify>;

		region: string,
		request: FormRequest
	): Promise<readonly { value: string; label: string }[]>;

export interface VersionedDraft {

export interface DraftAdapter {
	read(request: FormRequest): Promise<VersionedDraft | undefined>;

export interface FormPageProps {
	readonly identity: FormIdentity;
	readonly services: FormServices;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	readonly configurationVersion?: string;

export interface FormPageEvents {
	saved: [receipt: FormReceipt];

export interface FormPageExpose {

	cancel(): void;

export interface FormSessionConfig {
	readonly page: FormPage;
	readonly services: FormServices;
	readonly identity: FormIdentity;
	readonly bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[];
	readonly coordinator?: AsamWriteCoordinator;
	/** 与借入协调器一起跨服务配置替换保留原operationId。 */
	readonly pendingOperations?: Map<string, string>;
	readonly canWrite?: () => boolean;
	readonly validate?: (
		model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		signal: AbortSignal
	) => Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>;
	readonly onSaved?: (receipt: FormReceipt) => void;
}
export type FormPageSession = ReturnType<typeof createFormPageSession>;

import { templateText } from './i18n/index.js';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import type { TemplateMessageKey } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { AsamFieldViewBinding } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createAsamWriteCoordinator } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createFormPageSession, identityKey } from './Session.js';
import type {
	FormPage,
	FormPageProps,
	FormPageSession,
	FormReceipt,
	FormSessionConfig
} from './Types.js';

export function useFormPage(
	props: FormPageProps,
	page: FormPage,
	bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[],
	onSaved: (receipt: FormReceipt) => void,
	validate?: FormSessionConfig['validate']
) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const errorKey = shallowRef<TemplateMessageKey>();
	const session = shallowRef<FormPageSession>();
	const ready = shallowRef(0);
	const error = shallowRef('');
	let owned = false;
	const coordinator = createAsamWriteCoordinator();
	const pendingOperations = new Map<string, string>();
	let generation = 0;
	let stopResult: (() => void) | undefined;
	let removeValidation: (() => void) | undefined;
	let borrowedConfiguration:
		{ session: FormPageSession; version: string | undefined } | undefined;
	watch(
		() =>
			[
				identityKey(props.identity),
				props.services,
				props.session,
				props.configurationVersion
			] as const,
		async () => {
			const token = ++generation;
			stopResult?.();
			removeValidation?.();
			const reuse = owned && !props.session && session.value?.services === props.services;
			if (owned && !reuse) session.value?.dispose();
			owned = !props.session;
			error.value = '';
			errorKey.value = undefined;
			const current =
				props.session ??
				(reuse
					? session.value!
					: createFormPageSession({
							page,
							services: props.services,
							identity: props.identity,
							bindings,
							coordinator,
							pendingOperations
						}));
			session.value = current;
			if (
				props.session &&
				borrowedConfiguration?.session === current &&
				borrowedConfiguration.version !== props.configurationVersion
			) {
				error.value = '借入会话配置版本已变化，请由宿主提供新会话';
				errorKey.value =
					'app.templates.forms.theBorrowedSessionConfigurationChangedTheHostMustProvide';
				return;
			}
			if (
				current.page !== page ||
				current.services !== props.services ||
				(!owned && identityKey(current.identity()) !== identityKey(props.identity))
			) {
				error.value = '借入会话与页面、服务或身份不匹配，需由宿主重新配置';
				errorKey.value =
					'app.templates.forms.theBorrowedSessionDoesNotMatchThisPageServices';
				return;
			}
			current.setAccess(!!props.disabled, !!props.readonly);
			if (props.session)
				borrowedConfiguration = { session: current, version: props.configurationVersion };
			removeValidation = validate && current.addValidator(validate);
			stopResult = watch(
				current.result,
				(receipt) => {
					if (
						receipt &&
						token === generation &&
						identityKey(current.identity()) === identityKey(props.identity)
					)
						onSaved({ ...receipt });
				},
				{ flush: 'sync' }
			);
			if (owned) await current.open(props.identity);
			if (token === generation) ready.value++;
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	watch(
		() => [props.disabled, props.readonly] as const,
		([disabled, readonly]) => {
			session.value?.setAccess(!!disabled, !!readonly);
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(() => {
		generation++;
		stopResult?.();
		removeValidation?.();
		if (owned) session.value?.dispose();
	});
	const active = computed(() => session.value!);
	const isCurrent = () =>
		!error.value &&
		active.value.services === props.services &&
		identityKey(active.value.identity()) === identityKey(props.identity);
	const captureGuard = (current = active.value) => {
		const token = generation;
		return () => token === generation && active.value === current && isCurrent();
	};
	return {
		session: active,
		ready,
		error: computed(() => (errorKey.value ? templateText(i18n, errorKey.value) : error.value)),
		isCurrent,
		captureGuard
	};
}

import type { AsamEditIssue, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { modesFor, stepBindings } from './Models.js';

export async function validateBasic(
	model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
	signal: AbortSignal
): Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]> {
	if (signal.aborted) return [];
	const issues: AsamEditIssue[] = [];
	if (typeof model.name !== 'string' || model.name.trim().length < 2)
		issues.push({ key: 'name', message: '申请名称至少填写两个字符' });
	if (typeof model.code !== 'string' || !model.code.trim())
		issues.push({ key: 'code', message: '请填写业务编号，字符串 0 是合法编号' });
	if (model.quantity === null || model.quantity === undefined)
		issues.push({ key: 'quantity', message: '请填写数量，数值 0 是合法数量' });
	if (model.date === null || model.date === undefined)
		issues.push({ key: 'date', message: '请选择计划日期' });
	return issues;
}
export async function validateStep(
	model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
	keys: readonly string[],
	signal: AbortSignal
): Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]> {
	const basic = (await validateBasic(model, signal)).filter(
		(issue) => issue.key && keys.includes(issue.key)
	);
	const transformed = modesFor(
		stepBindings.filter((binding) => keys.includes(binding.field.key))
	).transform(model, 'submit');
	if (transformed.status === 'error') basic.push(...transformed.issues);
	if (
		keys.includes('department') &&
		(typeof model.department !== 'string' || !model.department.startsWith(`${model.region}-`))
	)
		basic.push({ key: 'department', message: '请等待地区部门读取完成并选择当前地区的部门' });
	if (keys.includes('contact') && (typeof model.contact !== 'string' || !model.contact.trim()))
		basic.push({ key: 'contact', message: '请填写联系人' });
	if (
		keys.includes('email') &&
		(typeof model.email !== 'string' || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(model.email))
	)
		basic.push({ key: 'email', message: '请输入完整邮箱' });
	if (keys.includes('confirmed') && model.confirmed !== true)
		basic.push({ key: 'confirmed', message: '请确认申请资料' });
	return basic;
}
