.forms-demo {
	/* 本页辅助文字沿用ASAM正文token，保持亮暗模式中的可读对比度。 */
	--asam-color-text-secondary: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	min-height: 100%;
	line-height: 1.6;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
* {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.forms-demo-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg) var(--asam-space-xl);
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}
.forms-demo-toolbar label {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	align-items: center;
}
.forms-demo-toolbar a {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	text-decoration: none;
	padding: var(--asam-space-xs);
}
.forms-demo-toolbar a[aria-current='page'] {
	color: var(--asam-color-primary);
	border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
}
.forms-demo-toolbar select:not([class*='el-']) {
	max-width: 160px;
	padding: var(--asam-space-xs);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
.forms-page {
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto;
	padding: 48px 40px;
}
.forms-header {
	margin-bottom: 36px;
	max-width: 760px;
}
.forms-eyebrow {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xs);
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
}
.forms-header h1 {
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 36px);
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-bold);
}
.forms-description,
.forms-help {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}
.forms-workspace {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 260px;
	gap: 40px;
	align-items: start;
}
.forms-content {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 32px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
}
.forms-content h2,
.forms-aside h2 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
}
.forms-count {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-regular);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}
.forms-field {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	margin: 24px 0;
	min-width: 0;
}
.forms-field > label {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-md);
	line-height: 1.6;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.forms-field > :not(label) {
	max-width: 100%;
}
.forms-aside {
	border-top: 2px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	padding-top: var(--asam-space-xl);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.forms-aside dl,
.forms-result dl {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
.forms-aside dt,
.forms-result dt {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
}
.forms-aside dd,
.forms-result dd {
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.forms-actions,
.forms-step-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
	margin-top: 28px;
	align-items: center;
}
.forms-feedback {
	max-width: 760px;
}
.forms-feedback .forms-issue-link {
	text-align: start;
	white-space: normal;
	text-decoration: underline;
}
.forms-field-error {
	color: var(--asam-semantic-danger-foreground);
	margin: 0;
}
.forms-notice,
.forms-result {
	padding: 32px;
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
}
.forms-notice h2,
.forms-result h2 {
	margin-top: 0;
}
.forms-result {
	max-width: 760px;
	animation: forms-feedback-in 160ms ease-out;
}
.forms-mode {
	padding: var(--asam-space-sm) var(--asam-space-lg);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	border-left: 3px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.forms-page.steps .forms-content {
	border-top: 3px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.forms-page.steps nav[aria-label='表单步骤'] {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	margin: 24px 0 32px;
}
.forms-page.advanced .forms-workspace {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 220px;
	gap: 24px;
}
.forms-page.advanced .forms-content {
	padding: 24px;
}
.forms-page.advanced .asam-schema-form {
	--asam-schema-field-min-width: 13rem;
}
.forms-demo-log {
	max-width: 1100px;
	padding: 0 40px 40px;
	margin: auto;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}
/* Date and time controls draw focus on their visible wrapper. */
.forms-demo :focus-visible:not(:where(.asam-date-time-control .el-input__wrapper > input)) {
	outline: 2px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
@keyframes forms-feedback-in {
	from {
		opacity: 0.7;
		transform: translateY(4px);
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.forms-result {
		animation: none;
	}
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.forms-page {
		padding: 28px 16px;
	}
	.forms-header {
		margin-bottom: 28px;
	}
	.forms-workspace,
	.forms-page.advanced .forms-workspace {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		gap: 24px;
	}
	.forms-content,
	.forms-page.advanced .forms-content {
		padding: 20px 16px;
	}
	.forms-demo-toolbar {
		gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
		padding: var(--asam-space-lg);
		font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
	}
	.forms-notice,
	.forms-result {
		padding: 24px 16px;
	}
	.forms-demo-log {
		padding: 0 16px 24px;
	}
}

/* Authored template actions keep translated labels reachable at narrow widths. */
.template-message-button.el-button {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	min-height: var(--el-component-size, 32px);
	margin-inline: 0;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.template-message-button.el-button > span {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	display: block;
}

let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix: string | undefined;

/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import '../templates/forms/style.css';
import App from '../templates/forms/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	createApp(App).mount(element);
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

		</p>

			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.loadingOptionsForTheCurrentRegion') }}
		</p>
		<AsamSchemaForm
			v-if="model"
			ref="form"
			:model-value="model"
			:schema="schema"
			:session="session.revision.value"
			:size="size"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:disabled="disabled || session.editor.busy.value || session.state.value !== 'editing'"
			@update:model-value="updateModel"
			@submit="save"
			><template #actions="{ submit: validateAndSubmit }"
				><AsamButton
					class="template-message-button"
					type="primary"
					:size="size"
					:disabled="
						!session.writable.value ||
						session.editor.busy.value ||
						session.state.value !== 'editing'
					"
					@click="submitSchema(validateAndSubmit)"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.validateAllGroupsAndSave') }}</AsamButton
				></template
			></AsamSchemaForm
		><template #summary
			><h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.modelAndSubmissionRules') }}</h2>
			<dl>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.detailRows') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ model?.items?.length ?? 0 }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.retainHiddenValuesAndSubmit') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.additionalInformationRetainedNote') }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.clearHiddenValuesAndOmit') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.additionalInformationTemporaryNote') }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.retainHiddenValuesAndOmit') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.contactInformationInternalNote') }}</dd>
				<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.currencyAndDate') }}</dt>
				<dd>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.cnyYuanCalendarDateNoAutomaticExchange') }}</dd>
			</dl>
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.expandTheErrorSummaryToLocateThe') }}</p></template
		></PageFrame
	>
</template>
<script setup>
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamSchemaForm } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { advancedBindings } from './Models.js';
import { createAdvancedSchema } from './AdvancedSchema.js';
import { useFormPage } from './UsePage.js';
import { identityKey } from './Session.js';
import PageFrame from './PageFrame.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	identity: { type: Object, required: true },
	services: { type: Object, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	configurationVersion: { type: String, required: false, default: '1' },
	session: { type: null, required: false },
	draftAdapter: { type: Object, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['saved', 'cancel']);
const { session, ready, error, isCurrent, captureGuard } = useFormPage(
	props,
	'P08',
	advancedBindings,
	(receipt) => emit('saved', receipt)
);
const model = shallowRef();
const form = shallowRef();
const pendingOptions = ref(0);
const reads = new Set();
watch(
	() => session.value.revision.value,
	() => {
		reads.clear();
		pendingOptions.value = 0;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => reads.clear());
const schema = computed(() => {
	void props.configurationVersion;
	const services = props.services,
		identity = { ...props.identity };
	return createAdvancedSchema(
		{
			async departments(region, request) {
				if (
					!isCurrent() ||
					request.signal.aborted ||
					session.value.services !== services ||
					identityKey(session.value.identity()) !== identityKey(identity)
				)
					throw new DOMException('选项会话已失效', 'AbortError');
				const token = Symbol('options');
				const clear = () => {
					if (reads.delete(token)) pendingOptions.value = reads.size;
				};
				reads.add(token);
				pendingOptions.value = reads.size;
				request.signal.addEventListener('abort', clear, { once: true });
				try {
					return await services.departments(region, request);
				} finally {
					request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', clear);
					clear();
				}
			}
		},
		identity
	);
});
let pendingSave;
function syncModel() {
	const document = session.value.snapshot().document;
	model.value = document && typeof document === 'object' ? document : undefined;
}
watch(ready, syncModel, { immediate: true });
function updateModel(value) {
	if (!isCurrent()) return;
	model.value = value;
	session.value.replace({ document: value });
}
function save(payload) {
	if (!isCurrent() || !session.value.writable.value || !model.value) return;
	// 015已处理隐藏映射；不将payload反写覆盖完整编辑模型。
	const active = session.value;
	if (!active.replace({ document: payload })) return;
	pendingSave = active.submit(captureGuard(active));
}
async function submitSchema(action) {
	await action();
	return (await pendingSave) ?? false;
}
async function submit() {
	if (!isCurrent()) return false;
	pendingSave = undefined;
	await form.value?.submit();
	return (await pendingSave) ?? false;
}
async function locatePageIssue() {
	await nextTick();
	await form.value?.locate(JSON.stringify(['profile-name']));
}
function cancel() {
	if (isCurrent()) session.value.cancel();
	emit('cancel');
}
defineExpose({
	reload: async () => {
		if (!isCurrent()) return;
		await session.value.reload();
		syncModel();
	},
	submit,
	verify: () => (isCurrent() ? session.value.verify() : Promise.resolve()),
	cancel
});
</script>

import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import { asamFormControls, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamNestedSchema,
	validateAsamNumber,
	validateAsamTemporal
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const isString = (value) => typeof value === 'string';
const isNumber = (value) => typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value);
const isBoolean = (value) => typeof value === 'boolean';
const stringValue = {
	control: asamFormControls.Input,
	componentProps: { clearable: true, validateEvent: false },
	isValue: isString,
	input: (value) => value,
	output: (value) => value,
	format: (value, context) =>
		value || (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.notEntered') ?? '未填写'),
	clearValue: () => ''
};
const numberValue = {
	control: asamFormControls.InputNumber,
	componentProps: { min: 0, validateEvent: false },
	isValue: isNumber,
	input: (value) => {
		if (value === undefined) throw new TypeError('此数值必填；清空不会自动转换为0');
		return value;
	},
	output: (value) => value,
	format: (value) => String(value),
	clearValue: () => 0
};
const booleanValue = {
	control: asamFormControls.Switch,
	componentProps: { validateEvent: false },
	isValue: isBoolean,
	input: (value) => value,
	output: (value) => value,
	format: (value, context) =>
		value
			? (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.yes') ?? '是')
			: (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.no') ?? '否'),
	clearValue: () => false
};
/** 5组：4×5个单值字段 + 5行×2个叶字段 = 30叶；rowKey为业务元数据，不冒充输入字段。 */
export function createAdvancedSchema(services, identity) {
	const profile = createAsamNestedSchema();
	const finance = createAsamNestedSchema();
	const contact = createAsamNestedSchema();
	const policy = createAsamNestedSchema();
	const row = createAsamNestedSchema();
	const region = { id: 'profile-region', scope: 'root' };
	const publish = { id: 'policy-publish', scope: 'root' };
	const showPrivate = { id: 'contact-show-private', scope: 'root' };
	return [
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'profile',
			label: '01 申请身份',
			path: ['profile'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				profile.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'profile-name',
					label: '申请名称',
					path: ['name'],
					validate: (value) =>
						typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length >= 2
							? undefined
							: '申请名称至少两个字符'
				}),
				profile.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'profile-code',
					label: '业务编号（异步校验，reserved 被占用）',
					path: ['code'],
					validate: async (value, { signal }) => {
						await new Promise((resolve) => {
							const timer = setTimeout(done, 60);
							function done() {
								signal.removeEventListener('abort', stop);
								resolve();
							}
							function stop() {
								clearTimeout(timer);
								done();
							}
							signal.addEventListener('abort', stop, { once: true });
							if (signal.aborted) stop();
						});
						return signal.aborted
							? undefined
							: !value
								? '业务编号不能为空'
								: value === 'reserved'
									? '该业务编号已被占用'
									: undefined;
					}
				}),
				profile.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'profile-enabled',
					label: '启用申请',
					path: ['enabled']
				}),
				profile.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'profile-region',
					label: '地区（east / west）',
					path: ['region'],
					validate: (value) =>
						['east', 'west'].includes(String(value))
							? undefined
							: '地区仅支持 east / west'
				}),
				profile.field({
					id: 'profile-department',
					label: '当前地区部门（异步选项）',
					path: ['department'],
					control: asamFormControls.RemoteSelect,
					componentProps: {
						placeholder: '选择当前地区部门',
						clearable: true,
						validateEvent: false
					},
					isValue: isString,
					input: (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''),
					output: (value) => value,
					format: (value, context) =>
						value || (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.notSelected') ?? '待选择'),
					clearValue: () => '',
					dependsOn: [region],
					onDependencyChange: 'clear',
					resolveDataSource: (context) => {
						const selected = String(context.get(region));
						return defineAsamOptions().api({
							api: async (_params, context) =>
								services.departments(selected, {
									...identity,
									page: 'P08',
									signal: context.signal
								}),
							params: selected
						});
					}
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'finance',
			label: '02 财务信息',
			path: ['finance'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				finance.field({
					...numberValue,
					id: 'finance-amount',
					label: '预算（CNY 元，不换币）',
					path: ['amount'],
					componentProps: { min: 0, validateEvent: false },
					validate: (value) =>
						validateAsamNumber(value, {
							key: 'amount',
							label: '预算',
							precision: 2,
							min: 0,
							required: true
						})
							.map((issue) => issue.message)
							.join('；') || undefined
				}),
				finance.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'finance-currency',
					label: '币种（只读）',
					path: ['currency'],
					readonly: true,
					validate: (value) =>
						value === 'CNY'
							? undefined
							: '当前模板仅声明CNY；请由宿主明确处理币种，不自动换汇'
				}),
				finance.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'finance-cost-code',
					label: '成本中心',
					path: ['costCode']
				}),
				finance.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'finance-invoice',
					label: '需要发票',
					path: ['invoice']
				}),
				finance.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'finance-tax-note',
					label: '开票说明（未选发票时禁用）',
					path: ['taxNote'],
					dependsOn: [{ id: 'finance-invoice' }],
					disabled: (context) => context.get({ id: 'finance-invoice' }) !== true
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'contact',
			label: '03 联系信息',
			path: ['contact'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-name',
					label: '联系人',
					path: ['name']
				}),
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-phone',
					label: '联系电话（保留原文）',
					path: ['phone']
				}),
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-email',
					label: '邮箱',
					path: ['email'],
					validate: (value) =>
						/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(value))
							? undefined
							: '请输入完整邮箱'
				}),
				contact.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'contact-show-private',
					label: '展示内部备注',
					path: ['showPrivate']
				}),
				contact.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'contact-private-note',
					label: '内部备注（隐藏保留，不提交）',
					path: ['privateNote'],
					dependsOn: [showPrivate],
					hidden: (context) => context.get(showPrivate) !== true,
					onHide: 'retain',
					submitHidden: false
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'grid',
			id: 'policy',
			label: '04 提交策略',
			path: ['policy'],
			columns: 2,
			children: [
				policy.field({
					...booleanValue,
					id: 'policy-publish',
					label: '发布补充信息',
					path: ['publish']
				}),
				policy.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'policy-keep-note',
					label: '保留说明（隐藏保留且提交）',
					path: ['keepNote'],
					dependsOn: [publish],
					hidden: (context) => context.get(publish) !== true,
					onHide: 'retain',
					submitHidden: true
				}),
				policy.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'policy-clear-note',
					label: '临时说明（隐藏清空且省略）',
					path: ['clearNote'],
					dependsOn: [publish],
					hidden: (context) => context.get(publish) !== true,
					onHide: 'clear',
					submitHidden: false
				}),
				policy.field({
					id: 'policy-date',
					label: '计划日期（无时区）',
					path: ['date'],
					control: asamFormControls.DatePicker,
					componentProps: {
						type: 'date',
						valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
						validateEvent: false
					},
					isValue: isString,
					input: (value) => value ?? '',
					output: (value) => value,
					format: (value) => value,
					clearValue: () => '',
					validate: (value) =>
						validateAsamTemporal(value, {
							key: 'date',
							label: '计划日期',
							kind: 'date',
							required: true
						})
							.map((issue) => issue.message)
							.join('；') || undefined
				}),
				policy.field({
					id: 'policy-resource',
					label: '资料ID（只读合成引用，可为null）',
					path: ['resourceId'],
					control: asamFormControls.Input,
					componentProps: { validateEvent: false },
					readonly: true,
					isValue: (value) => value === null || typeof value === 'string',
					input: (value) => value,
					output: (value) => value ?? '',
					format: (value, context) =>
						value === null
							? (context?.i18n?.t('app.templates.forms.noResourceNull') ??
								'无资料 null')
							: value,
					clearValue: () => null
				})
			]
		},
		{
			kind: 'array',
			id: 'items',
			label: '05 设备明细',
			path: ['items'],
			rowKey: ['rowKey'],
			min: 1,
			max: 12,
			permissions: { add: true, remove: true, move: true },
			createRow: () => ({ rowKey: createTemplateId(), name: '新增设备', quantity: 0 }),
			children: [
				row.field({
					...stringValue,
					id: 'item-name',
					label: '设备名称',
					path: ['name'],
					validate: (value) =>
						typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? undefined : '设备名称不能为空'
				}),
				row.field({
					...numberValue,
					id: 'item-quantity',
					label: '设备数量',
					path: ['quantity'],
					componentProps: { min: 0, precision: 0, validateEvent: false },
					validate: (value) =>
						typeof value === 'number' && value >= 0 && Number.isInteger(value)
							? undefined
							: '设备数量须为非负整数'
				})
			]
		}
	];
}

<template>
	<AsamApplicationProvider :config="{ base: { i18n }, colorMode: dark ? 'dark' : 'light', size }"

									i18n.t('app.templates.forms.changeEntityAndVersion')

							><AsamCheckboxItem

								@update:model-value="updateBoolean('second', $event)"

									i18n.t('app.templates.forms.secondInstance')

							><AsamCheckboxItem
								:model-value="mounted"
								@update:model-value="updateBoolean('mounted', $event)"
								border
								>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.forms.mountPage') }}</AsamCheckboxItem
							>
						</nav>
					</section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
				></Teleport
			><component
				:is="currentPage"
				v-if="mounted"
				:key="page"
				ref="view"
				:identity="identity"

	>
</template>
<script setup>
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event) {
	updateBoolean('dark', event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value, type) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import BasicFormPage from './BasicFormPage.vue';
import StepsFormPage from './StepsFormPage.vue';
import AdvancedFormPage from './AdvancedFormPage.vue';
import { createSyntheticServices } from './SyntheticServices.js';
const pages = [
	{
		id: 'P06',
		get title() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.forms.basicApplication');
		}
	},
	{
		id: 'P07',
		get title() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.forms.stepApplication');
		}
	},
	{
		id: 'P08',
		get title() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.forms.combinedApplication');
		}
	}
];
const parsePage = () => pages.find((item) => location.hash === `#/${item.id}`)?.id ?? 'P06';
const page = ref(parsePage());
const onHash = () => {
	page.value = parsePage();
};
window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHash);
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash));
const currentPage = computed(() =>
	page.value === 'P06' ? BasicFormPage : page.value === 'P07' ? StepsFormPage : AdvancedFormPage
);
const identity = shallowRef({ scope: 'forms-demo', entity: 'A-001', version: '1' });
const sizes = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref('default');
const dark = ref(false),
	readonly = ref(false),
	disabled = ref(false),
	second = ref(false),
	mounted = ref(true);
const scenarios = [
	'normal',
	'empty',
	'load-error',
	'invalid-model',
	'validation-error',
	'save-error',
	'unknown',
	'verify-unknown',

	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },

});

}

	if (props.error) return;
	await props.session.reopenDraft();

	await props.session.newEdit();
	emit('loaded');
}

<template>

						i18n.t('app.templates.forms.reloadDepartments')
					}}</AsamButton>
				</p>

import { baseline, copyModel } from './Models.js';
import { identityKey } from './Session.js';
/** 一个工厂调用一个内存后端；不跨实例共享、不读写浏览器持久存储。 */
export function createSyntheticServices(initial = 'normal') {
	let scenario = initial;
	const writes = new Map();
	const records = new Map();
	const calls = [];
	const record = (operation, request, operationId) =>
		calls.push({ operation, identity: identityKey(request), operationId });
	const pause = (signal, ms = 100) =>
		new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			if (signal.aborted) return reject(new DOMException('会话取消', 'AbortError'));
			const cancel = () => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				reject(new DOMException('会话取消', 'AbortError'));
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				resolve();
			}, ms);
			signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		});
	const key = (request) =>
		JSON.stringify([identityKey(request), request.page, request.operationId]);
	const recordKey = (request) => JSON.stringify([identityKey(request), request.page]);
	function decode(dto, request) {
		const previous = records.get(recordKey(request)) ?? baseline(request.page);
		if (request.page === 'P08') {
			const merge = (base, value) => {
				if (value === undefined) return base;
				if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
					return value;
				const original = base && typeof base === 'object' ? base : {};
				return Object.fromEntries(
					[...new Set([...Object.keys(original), ...Object.keys(value)])].map((key) => [
						key,
						merge(Reflect.get(original, key), Reflect.get(value, key))
					])
				);
			};
			return copyModel({ document: merge(previous.document, dto.document) });
		}
		const model = copyModel(dto);
		if (
			model.budget !== null &&
			typeof model.budget === 'object' &&
			model.budget &&
			'amount' in model.budget &&
			'currency' in model.budget &&
			'unit' in model.budget
		) {
			if (
				model.budget.currency !== 'CNY' ||
				model.budget.unit !== 'major' ||
				typeof model.budget.amount !== 'number'
			)
				throw new Error('合成服务只接受显式CNY元金额');
			model.budget = model.budget.amount;
		}
		if (request.page === 'P06') {
			model.resource = model.resourceId;
			delete model.resourceId;
		}
		return model;
	}
	const services = {
		async load(request) {
			record('load', request);
			await pause(request.signal);
			if (scenario === 'load-error') throw new Error('合成读取失败，可恢复后重试');
			if (scenario === 'invalid-model')
				return {
					status: 'found',
					model:
						request.page === 'P08'
							? { document: {} }
							: { ...baseline(request.page), quantity: '0' }
				};
			return scenario === 'empty'
				? { status: 'empty' }
				: {
						status: 'found',
						model: copyModel(records.get(recordKey(request)) ?? baseline(request.page))
					};
		},
		async validate(dto, request) {
			record('validate', request);
			await pause(request.signal, 40);
			if (scenario === 'validation-error')
				return [
					{
						key: request.page === 'P08' ? 'document' : 'name',
						message: '合成页面校验未通过，请更正后提交'
					}
				];
			if (request.page !== 'P08' && dto.code === 'reserved')
				return [{ key: 'code', message: '业务编号已被占用' }];
			return [];
		},
		async submit(dto, request) {
			record('submit', request, request.operationId);
			await pause(request.signal);
			if (scenario === 'save-error')
				return {
					status: 'failure',
					message: '合成保存未生效，可显式再次保存',
					issues: [{ key: 'name', message: '请确认申请名称' }]
				};
			const receipt = {
				operationId: request.operationId,
				entity: request.entity,
				version: request.version,
				summary: `申请 ${request.entity} 已保存（合成内存服务）`
			};
			writes.set(key(request), { receipt, dto: copyModel(dto) });
			if (scenario !== 'verify-not-applied')
				records.set(recordKey(request), decode(dto, request));
			return ['unknown', 'verify-unknown', 'verify-not-applied'].includes(scenario)
				? { status: 'unknown', message: '保存响应未知；仅核实原操作，不自动重发' }
				: { status: 'success', receipt };
		},
		async verify(request) {
			record('verify', request, request.operationId);
			await pause(request.signal);
			if (scenario === 'verify-unknown') return { status: 'unknown' };
			if (scenario === 'verify-not-applied') {
				writes.delete(key(request));
				return { status: 'not-applied' };
			}
			const saved = writes.get(key(request));
			return saved
				? { status: 'success', receipt: { ...saved.receipt } }
				: { status: 'not-applied' };
		},
		async departments(region, request) {
			record('departments', request);
			await pause(request.signal);
			return [
				{ value: `${region}-ops`, label: region === 'east' ? '东部运营' : '西部运营' },
				{ value: `${region}-lab`, label: '研究支持' }
			];
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		calls,
		writes,
		setScenario: (next) => {
			scenario = next;
		}
	};
}

import { templateText } from './i18n/index.js';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createAsamWriteCoordinator } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createFormPageSession, identityKey } from './Session.js';
export function useFormPage(props, page, bindings, onSaved, validate) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const errorKey = shallowRef();
	const session = shallowRef();
	const ready = shallowRef(0);
	const error = shallowRef('');
	let owned = false;
	const coordinator = createAsamWriteCoordinator();
	const pendingOperations = new Map();
	let generation = 0;
	let stopResult;
	let removeValidation;
	let borrowedConfiguration;
	watch(
		() => [
			identityKey(props.identity),
			props.services,
			props.session,
			props.configurationVersion
		],
		async () => {
			const token = ++generation;
			stopResult?.();
			removeValidation?.();
			const reuse = owned && !props.session && session.value?.services === props.services;
			if (owned && !reuse) session.value?.dispose();
			owned = !props.session;
			error.value = '';
			errorKey.value = undefined;
			const current =
				props.session ??
				(reuse
					? session.value
					: createFormPageSession({
							page,
							services: props.services,
							identity: props.identity,
							bindings,
							coordinator,
							pendingOperations
						}));
			session.value = current;
			if (
				props.session &&
				borrowedConfiguration?.session === current &&
				borrowedConfiguration.version !== props.configurationVersion
			) {
				error.value = '借入会话配置版本已变化，请由宿主提供新会话';
				errorKey.value =
					'app.templates.forms.theBorrowedSessionConfigurationChangedTheHostMustProvide';
				return;
			}
			if (
				current.page !== page ||
				current.services !== props.services ||
				(!owned && identityKey(current.identity()) !== identityKey(props.identity))
			) {
				error.value = '借入会话与页面、服务或身份不匹配，需由宿主重新配置';
				errorKey.value =
					'app.templates.forms.theBorrowedSessionDoesNotMatchThisPageServices';
				return;
			}
			current.setAccess(!!props.disabled, !!props.readonly);
			if (props.session)
				borrowedConfiguration = { session: current, version: props.configurationVersion };
			removeValidation = validate && current.addValidator(validate);
			stopResult = watch(
				current.result,
				(receipt) => {
					if (
						receipt &&
						token === generation &&
						identityKey(current.identity()) === identityKey(props.identity)
					)
						onSaved({ ...receipt });
				},
				{ flush: 'sync' }
			);
			if (owned) await current.open(props.identity);
			if (token === generation) ready.value++;
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	watch(
		() => [props.disabled, props.readonly],
		([disabled, readonly]) => {
			session.value?.setAccess(!!disabled, !!readonly);
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(() => {
		generation++;
		stopResult?.();
		removeValidation?.();
		if (owned) session.value?.dispose();
	});
	const active = computed(() => session.value);
	const isCurrent = () =>
		!error.value &&
		active.value.services === props.services &&
		identityKey(active.value.identity()) === identityKey(props.identity);
	const captureGuard = (current = active.value) => {
		const token = generation;
		return () => token === generation && active.value === current && isCurrent();
	};
	return {
		session: active,
		ready,
		error: computed(() => (errorKey.value ? templateText(i18n, errorKey.value) : error.value)),
		isCurrent,
		captureGuard
	};
}

import { modesFor, stepBindings } from './Models.js';
export async function validateBasic(model, signal) {
	if (signal.aborted) return [];
	const issues = [];
	if (typeof model.name !== 'string' || model.name.trim().length < 2)
		issues.push({ key: 'name', message: '申请名称至少填写两个字符' });
	if (typeof model.code !== 'string' || !model.code.trim())
		issues.push({ key: 'code', message: '请填写业务编号，字符串 0 是合法编号' });
	if (model.quantity === null || model.quantity === undefined)
		issues.push({ key: 'quantity', message: '请填写数量，数值 0 是合法数量' });
	if (model.date === null || model.date === undefined)
		issues.push({ key: 'date', message: '请选择计划日期' });
	return issues;
}
export async function validateStep(model, keys, signal) {
	const basic = (await validateBasic(model, signal)).filter(
		(issue) => issue.key && keys.includes(issue.key)
	);
	const transformed = modesFor(
		stepBindings.filter((binding) => keys.includes(binding.field.key))
	).transform(model, 'submit');
	if (transformed.status === 'error') basic.push(...transformed.issues);
	if (
		keys.includes('department') &&
		(typeof model.department !== 'string' || !model.department.startsWith(`${model.region}-`))
	)
		basic.push({ key: 'department', message: '请等待地区部门读取完成并选择当前地区的部门' });
	if (keys.includes('contact') && (typeof model.contact !== 'string' || !model.contact.trim()))
		basic.push({ key: 'contact', message: '请填写联系人' });
	if (
		keys.includes('email') &&
		(typeof model.email !== 'string' || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(model.email))
	)
		basic.push({ key: 'email', message: '请输入完整邮箱' });
	if (keys.includes('confirmed') && model.confirmed !== true)
		basic.push({ key: 'confirmed', message: '请确认申请资料' });
	return basic;
}

.forms-demo {
	/* 本页辅助文字沿用ASAM正文token，保持亮暗模式中的可读对比度。 */
	--asam-color-text-secondary: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	min-height: 100%;
	line-height: 1.6;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
* {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.forms-demo-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg) var(--asam-space-xl);
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}
.forms-demo-toolbar label {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	align-items: center;
}
.forms-demo-toolbar a {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	text-decoration: none;
	padding: var(--asam-space-xs);
}
.forms-demo-toolbar a[aria-current='page'] {
	color: var(--asam-color-primary);
	border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
}
.forms-demo-toolbar select:not([class*='el-']) {
	max-width: 160px;
	padding: var(--asam-space-xs);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
.forms-page {
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto;
	padding: 48px 40px;
}
.forms-header {
	margin-bottom: 36px;
	max-width: 760px;
}
.forms-eyebrow {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xs);
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
}
.forms-header h1 {
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 36px);
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-bold);
}
.forms-description,
.forms-help {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}
.forms-workspace {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 260px;
	gap: 40px;
	align-items: start;
}
.forms-content {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 32px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
}
.forms-content h2,
.forms-aside h2 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
}
.forms-count {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-regular);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}
.forms-field {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	margin: 24px 0;
	min-width: 0;
}
.forms-field > label {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-md);
	line-height: 1.6;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.forms-field > :not(label) {
	max-width: 100%;
}
.forms-aside {
	border-top: 2px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	padding-top: var(--asam-space-xl);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.forms-aside dl,
.forms-result dl {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
.forms-aside dt,
.forms-result dt {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
}
.forms-aside dd,
.forms-result dd {
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-lg);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.forms-actions,
.forms-step-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
	margin-top: 28px;
	align-items: center;
}
.forms-feedback {
	max-width: 760px;
}
.forms-feedback .forms-issue-link {
	text-align: start;
	white-space: normal;
	text-decoration: underline;
}
.forms-field-error {
	color: var(--asam-semantic-danger-foreground);
	margin: 0;
}
.forms-notice,
.forms-result {
	padding: 32px;
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
}
.forms-notice h2,
.forms-result h2 {
	margin-top: 0;
}
.forms-result {
	max-width: 760px;
	animation: forms-feedback-in 160ms ease-out;
}
.forms-mode {
	padding: var(--asam-space-sm) var(--asam-space-lg);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	border-left: 3px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.forms-page.steps .forms-content {
	border-top: 3px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.forms-page.steps nav[aria-label='表单步骤'] {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	margin: 24px 0 32px;
}
.forms-page.advanced .forms-workspace {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 220px;
	gap: 24px;
}
.forms-page.advanced .forms-content {
	padding: 24px;
}
.forms-page.advanced .asam-schema-form {
	--asam-schema-field-min-width: 13rem;
}
.forms-demo-log {
	max-width: 1100px;
	padding: 0 40px 40px;
	margin: auto;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}
/* Date and time controls draw focus on their visible wrapper. */
.forms-demo :focus-visible:not(:where(.asam-date-time-control .el-input__wrapper > input)) {
	outline: 2px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
@keyframes forms-feedback-in {
	from {
		opacity: 0.7;
		transform: translateY(4px);
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.forms-result {
		animation: none;
	}
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.forms-page {
		padding: 28px 16px;
	}
	.forms-header {
		margin-bottom: 28px;
	}
	.forms-workspace,
	.forms-page.advanced .forms-workspace {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		gap: 24px;
	}
	.forms-content,
	.forms-page.advanced .forms-content {
		padding: 20px 16px;
	}
	.forms-demo-toolbar {
		gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
		padding: var(--asam-space-lg);
		font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
	}
	.forms-notice,
	.forms-result {
		padding: 24px 16px;
	}
	.forms-demo-log {
		padding: 0 16px 24px;
	}
}

/* Authored template actions keep translated labels reachable at narrow widths. */
.template-message-button.el-button {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	min-height: var(--el-component-size, 32px);
	margin-inline: 0;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.template-message-button.el-button > span {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	display: block;
}

let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix;
/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId() {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

提供基础、分步和嵌套结构三类完整录入页面。

使用与 API

本目录通过完整应用源码接入，按下方接口与行为说明提供宿主依赖。

完整示例

独立挂载入口：website-hosts/forms.ts。复制全部依赖文件，按接入说明加载三份公共样式后，调用该入口导出的 await mountWebsiteExample(element, onError)，并在页面销毁时调用返回的释放函数。这个入口保留原示例的 router、provider 和上下文注入，不能只复制 App.vue。

继续接入

快速开始 · 版本与迁移 · AI 开发说明

接口、行为与迁移细节

接口与行为

三页面共用 FormPageProps：必填 identity:{scope,entity,version}、services:FormServices； 可选 disabled=false、readonly=false、size='default'（large/big/default/small = 40/36/32/28）、 configurationVersion='1'、session，分步录入可选 draftAdapter。 identity或configurationVersion变化废弃旧会话；services变化保留同实例协调器/原未决operationId。 借入session必须匹配page/services/identity，不匹配显示配置错误；页面不会销毁借入资源。 同一页面实例改变configurationVersion时，借入会话须由宿主换成新会话；旧借入会话保留给宿主，不静默改配或接收旧配置的迟到成功。

事件：saved(receipt:FormReceipt)仅在当前身份的服务确认成功或原操作核实成功时恰一次；cancel()仅表示关闭展示。 没有公开页面slot；布局修改直接编辑完整SFC。公共expose：reload():Promise<void>、 submit():Promise<boolean>、verify():Promise<void>、cancel():void。 submit返回true只表示该次当前会话服务确认；失败、未知、只读、禁用、取消/失效返回false。

FormServices：

方法 输入 结果/语义
load FormRequest(page/scope/entity/version/signal) found模型或empty；异常转读取错误，可重试
validate 显式转换后的DTO + FormRequest readonly AsamEditIssue[]；不触发写入
submit DTO + FormWrite(另含operationId) success(receipt)、failure(message/issues)、unknown(message)
verify 原FormWrite success(receipt)、not-applied、unknown；不得把未知当未生效
departments region + FormRequest 当前地区部门；旧结果、身份/地区变化和卸载隔离

FormReceipt必须匹配原operationId/entity/version。畸形或不匹配的“成功”按unknown处理，不能发成功。 请求传入独立快照；服务可同步回调宿主，保存前的最后边界仍复核身份、会话与写权限。 外部服务即使忽略abort，其迟到结果也不能覆盖新实体；已发送写的真实结果仍由编辑与详情协议协调器保留。 取消不承诺撤销外部副作用。只读允许读取/核实，不允许新写；禁用不借UI外观代替协议约束。

基础录入输入/DTO类型为 BasicInputModel/BasicSubmitDto；分步录入为 StepsInputModel/StepsSubmitDto。 界面可能含未通过校验的金额草稿，DTO只在转换成功后交服务；数值字符串不猜测为数字。 资源元数据只提取稳定ID，不二次提取；空值/缺失不做truthy转换。

分步录入向前只验当前步，后退保值；不允许任意跳过未来步骤，最终重新逐步校验全部模型。 后端字段错误回到其所属步骤；无key错误留在页面汇总。部门依赖晚到不能回填新地区。 DraftAdapter.read/write只通过显式按钮调用；默认无跨刷新存储，版本或身份不符拒绝应用。

高级录入 AdvancedModel为完整嵌套输入，Schema提交类型为 AsamSchemaSubmitModel<AdvancedModel>。 五组共30个初始叶：profile/finance/contact/policy各5个，items五行各2个。 rowKey只作为稳定业务元数据，0和'0'可同时存在。新增UUID由宿主页面提供，不用位置冒身份。 onDependencyChange:'clear'清部门，联系备注hidden时保留但省略，keepNote隐藏保留并提交，clearNote隐藏清空且省略。 金额CNY元/两位，日期YYYY-MM-DD，资料ID可null。异步编号校验尊重signal；错误可从Schema汇总定位。

createFormPageSession(config)用于普通宿主复用：editor/state/result/empty/cancelled/revision/writable、 identity()/operationId()/snapshot()、open/update/replace/cancel/dispose/submit/verify/reload/reopenDraft/newEdit。 coordinator/pendingOperations借入时由宿主持有；dispose只释放本会话自己的runtime/监听/校验和草稿，不dispose协调器/服务。 页面校验通过可移除的addValidator租约叠加，保留宿主validate；页面退出只移除自己的租约并废弃在途校验，不改写或销毁借入会话。 页面调用session.submit(guard?)时捕获该会话与当前页面身份，最后服务边界再核guard；借入会话不匹配时公开expose同样拒绝写入，不能只靠错误展示或disabled外观。 session.editor只公开只读状态视图；业务权限由session.writable和最后服务适配保护。原编辑与详情协议引擎通过正常公开hooks复用，不外泄可绕过页面身份的原始写方法。 newEdit不能绕过unknown；核实not-applied后才允许显式再写。业务权限始终以最后服务调用边界复核为准。

使用说明

BasicFormPage.vue、StepsFormPage.vue 与 AdvancedFormPage.vue 为完整可编辑页面。App.vue 提供三个 hash 入口和本地场景切换；main.ts 依次加载 Element Plus、UI、Pro 与页面样式。

页面 信息结构 默认规模 复用
基础录入 单列申请与侧边显示摘要，确认结果后返回编辑 12字段 字段模式与转换字段模式/转换、编辑与详情协议编辑器/写协调器
分步录入 3步申请、当前阶段内容、常驻摘要/草稿说明 每步5字段，共15字段 表单流程 AsamStepsForm、字段模式与转换转换、编辑与详情协议真实保存
高级录入 身份/财务/联系/策略/明细五组 20普通叶 + 5行×2叶 = 30；rowKey不计为叶 嵌套结构表单 AsamSchemaForm/类型工厂/控制器、编辑与详情协议写协调器

合成服务读取100ms、业务校验40ms、保存/核实100ms。各工厂调用各自持有内存；没有真实接口、文件上传、默认localStorage或跨刷新持久化。 初始 quantity=0、code='0'、enabled=false、note=''、nullable=null 和缺失的 optional 分别保真。 CNY金额以元/两位精度显式传输；日期为日历字符串，不猜时区；资源只提交稳定ID。

普通工程运行

Node 22.19.0、pnpm 11.9.0。先获得与当前完整源一一绑定的正常 UI / Pro tgz，再在独立工程执行：

sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build
pnpm run preview

保留模板的相对文件、匹配依赖、补丁与有效锁。通过普通 UI/Pro 包入口消费，业务服务由应用注入。

修改配方

  1. 修改基础录入标题、布局：编辑 BasicFormPage.vue 的普通template；字段名称/显示/DTO映射在 Models.ts 的 basicBindings 与 modesFor，校验在 Validation.ts。
  2. 修改分步录入阶段：编辑 Models.ts 的稳定 steps.id/keys，每个字段只归一个步骤；在 StepsFormPage.vue 的 validateCurrent 检查当前步。最终保存仍走 createFormPageSession，不能把 finish 当服务已确认。
  3. 修改高级录入结构：编辑 AdvancedSchema.ts，通过 createAsamNestedSchema<Model>().field 声明路径、注册控件和双向转换；新增数组行用业务rowKey，禁止数组下标。模型及初值同步修改 Types.ts/Models.ts。
  4. 修改服务：实现 FormServices 的 load/validate/submit/verify/departments。保持 scope/entity/version 与原operationId；unknown只能核实，不自动重写。合成 save-error 与 unknown 是真实可操作恢复场景。
  5. 增加草稿持久化：显式注入 DraftAdapter。adapter须校验 asam-forms-draft-v1、page、scope/entity/version 并尊重signal；默认草稿只在当前实例内存，刷新不恢复。
  6. 借入会话：宿主在自身生命周期创建 createFormPageSession，注入 session 与相同identity/services/page。页面不dispose借入会话；宿主负责权限、匹配及最终dispose。

页面属性、事件、实例方法与服务语义见下方接口说明。采用 ASAM tokens、公开控件和清楚的留白层级，保留页面信息结构。 简单CSS结果反馈160ms、减少动态关闭动画；不阻塞可操作性。基础/分步/分组的信息结构有实际差异，不将数据表单机械复制三套品牌样式。

完整类型

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
import type { createFormPageSession } from './Session.js';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamEditIssue,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamWriteCoordinator,
	AsamFieldViewBinding
} from '@asam-ui/pro';
import type { AsamMoneyInputValue, AsamMoneyPayload, AsamResourceValue } from '@asam-ui/pro';

export interface BasicInputModel {
	name: string;
	code: string;
	quantity: number | null;
	budget: AsamMoneyInputValue;
	date: string | null;
	category: AsamValue | null;
	enabled: boolean | null;
	tags: readonly AsamValue[];
	note: string;
	nullable: string | null;
	optional?: string;
	resource: AsamResourceValue;
}
export interface BasicSubmitDto extends Omit<BasicInputModel, 'budget' | 'resource'> {
	budget: AsamMoneyPayload | null;
	resourceId: string | number | null;
}
export interface StepsInputModel extends Omit<BasicInputModel, 'resource' | 'optional'> {
	region: string;
	department: string | null;
	contact: string;
	email: string;
	confirmed: boolean;
}
export interface StepsSubmitDto extends Omit<StepsInputModel, 'budget'> {
	budget: AsamMoneyPayload | null;
}

export type FormPage = 'P06' | 'P07' | 'P08';
export interface FormIdentity {
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly entity: string;
	/** 不推断后端版本；变化即开始新会话。 */
	readonly version: string;
}
export interface FormRequest extends FormIdentity {
	readonly page: FormPage;
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
}
export interface FormWrite extends FormRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface FormReceipt {
	readonly operationId: string;
	readonly entity: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly summary: string;
}
export type FormLoad =
	{ readonly status: 'found'; readonly model: AsamFieldModel } | { readonly status: 'empty' };
export type FormSubmit =
	| { readonly status: 'success'; readonly receipt: FormReceipt }
	| {
			readonly status: 'failure';
			readonly message: string;
			readonly issues?: readonly AsamEditIssue[];
	  }
	| { readonly status: 'unknown'; readonly message: string };
export type FormVerify =
	| { readonly status: 'success'; readonly receipt: FormReceipt }
	| { readonly status: 'not-applied' | 'unknown' };
export interface FormServices {
	load(request: FormRequest): Promise<FormLoad>;
	validate(
		dto: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		request: FormRequest
	): Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>;
	submit(dto: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>, request: FormWrite): Promise<FormSubmit>;
	verify(request: FormWrite): Promise<FormVerify>;
	/** P07 的真实异步依赖读取；不向库注入业务 URL。 */
	departments(
		region: string,
		request: FormRequest
	): Promise<readonly { value: string; label: string }[]>;
}
export interface VersionedDraft {
	readonly format: 'asam-forms-draft-v1';
	readonly identity: FormIdentity;
	readonly page: FormPage;
	readonly model: AsamFieldModel;
}
export interface DraftAdapter {
	read(request: FormRequest): Promise<VersionedDraft | undefined>;
	write(draft: VersionedDraft, request: FormRequest): Promise<void>;
}
export interface FormPageProps {
	readonly identity: FormIdentity;
	readonly services: FormServices;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	readonly configurationVersion?: string;
	/** 宿主借入会话由宿主销毁；其 page/services/identity 必须匹配。 */
	readonly session?: FormPageSession;
	readonly draftAdapter?: DraftAdapter;
}
export interface FormPageEvents {
	saved: [receipt: FormReceipt];
	cancel: [];
}
export interface FormPageExpose {
	reload(): Promise<void>;
	submit(): Promise<boolean>;
	verify(): Promise<void>;
	cancel(): void;
}
export interface FormSessionConfig {
	readonly page: FormPage;
	readonly services: FormServices;
	readonly identity: FormIdentity;
	readonly bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[];
	readonly coordinator?: AsamWriteCoordinator;
	/** 与借入协调器一起跨服务配置替换保留原operationId。 */
	readonly pendingOperations?: Map<string, string>;
	readonly canWrite?: () => boolean;
	readonly validate?: (
		model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		signal: AbortSignal
	) => Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>;
	readonly onSaved?: (receipt: FormReceipt) => void;
}
export type FormPageSession = ReturnType<typeof createFormPageSession>;

export interface AdvancedRow {
	rowKey: string | number;
	name: string;
	quantity: number;
}
export interface AdvancedModel {
	profile: { name: string; code: string; enabled: boolean; region: string; department: string };
	finance: {
		amount: number;
		currency: string;
		costCode: string;
		invoice: boolean;
		taxNote: string;
	};
	contact: {
		name: string;
		phone: string;
		email: string;
		showPrivate: boolean;
		privateNote: string;
	};
	policy: {
		publish: boolean;
		keepNote: string;
		clearNote: string;
		date: string;
		resourceId: string | null;
	};
	items: AdvancedRow[];
}
